title: Software Engineer, Data
description:
About Us 

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities. Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship .

About the Role 

As a member of the Data team, you will help build the services, infrastructure, and data platforms that power our business. Our team is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and distributing large volumes of data reliably and efficiently, enabling teams across the business to make data-driven decisions and build innovative products. 

This role sits at the intersection of backend software engineering and data engineering, with an emphasis on data engineering. You will build and maintain data pipelines, develop backend services for data ingestion and access, and contribute to the data infrastructure that enables reliable, cost-effective, and high-performance data processing. 

You'll work closely with software engineers, DevOps engineers, product managers, data consumers, and more experienced colleagues, who will provide guidance, code reviews, and support as you grow. While the role involves technical collaboration across the organization, it is primarily focused on engineering rather than stakeholder management. 

We are a trading company, so business requirements change quickly, and priorities can shift. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, takes ownership of their work, is eager to learn, and makes pragmatic engineering decisions in a dynamic environment. 

Responsibilities 

- Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and ingestion workflows for structured and unstructured data from a variety of internal and external sources, including fetching data from external providers. 

- Develop and maintain backend services and APIs (e.g., FastAPI ) that support data ingestion, processing, and distribution, including asynchronous ingestion at scale. 

- Transform and process data using Python and Pandas. 

- Contribute to reusable frameworks and tooling that simplify onboarding new data sources and improve developer productivity. 

- Work with data lakes, analytical and relational databases, and contribute to their design and optimization together with senior colleagues. 

- Help catalogue and document the data we own so it can be discovered and used by others. 

- Help improve the reliability, scalability, observability, and cost-efficiency of our data infrastructure. 

- Integrate data across multiple systems while reducing duplication and ensuring high data quality. 

- Contribute to orchestration workflows and automated data processing pipelines. 

- Build internal libraries and services that enable other engineering teams to access and consume data efficiently. 

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and fix issues in production systems and data pipelines, escalating when needed. 

- Participate in architecture discussions and technical decisions across the data platform. 

- Collaborate with software engineers, DevOps engineers, product managers, and data consumers to deliver high-impact solutions. 

- Build and maintain simple internal self-service tools, occasionally including a user interface. 

- Use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) responsibly to speed up development, while remaining accountable for the design, correctness, and quality of your code. 

- Identify opportunities to simplify systems, improve automation, and reduce operational overhead. 

About You 

The following education, experience, and skills are essential for this role: 

- Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. 

- Around 2+ years of professional experience in data engineering or backend development, with a focus on data pipelines and data-intensive systems. 

- Professional experience developing applications and services using Python, including data processing with Pandas or similar libraries. 

- Experience building or working with data pipelines (ETL/ELT) or data processing systems. 

- Solid SQL skills and experience working with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server). 

- Experience building RESTful APIs and backend services. 

- Familiarity with containerized applications (e.g., Docker) and basic software delivery practices such as Git and CI/CD. 

- Hands-on grounding in software engineering fundamentals: software design principles, programming paradigms, testing, and maintainability. You must be able to write, read, debug, and reason about code yourself. 

- Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) as a tool to work faster, including prompting them effectively and critically reviewing their output. AI supports your work; it does not replace your own engineering judgement. 

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing requirements, and to make pragmatic trade-offs. 

- Good problem-solving and analytical skills. 

- Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks while collaborating effectively within a team, and to ask for help when needed. 

- Ownership mentality and willingness to learn and take on more responsibility over time. 

- Good communication skills and fluent English. 

- Ideally, you have worked in a trading or similarly fast-moving business environment, such as commodities, financial services, or renewable energy. 

The following experience is desirable (not required ): 

- Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (e.g., S3, Glue, Athena, SQS, Lambda, ECS, CloudWatch). 

- Experience with analytical databases or query engines such as ClickHouse , Athena/Presto, or similar. 

- Familiarity with data lake or data warehouse concepts and file formats such as Parquet. 

- Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow. 

- Experience building services using FastAPI or similar modern Python frameworks. 

- Familiarity with messaging and asynchronous processing patterns, or streaming platforms such as Kafka. 

- Exposure to Infrastructure as Code and cloud-native architectures. 

- Interest in distributed systems and high-throughput data processing. 

- Exposure to observability, monitoring, and performance tuning. 

- Experience working in Agile software development environments. 

- Experience with frontend development (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, React) for building internal tools.

What we offer 

- Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.

- 28 days of annual holiday entitlement plus Berlin public holidays.

- €3,000 per year contribution to a private pension scheme on your behalf.

- €20 monthly subsidy towards BVG tickets.

- €25 monthly subsidy towards ClassPass membership.

- A subsidy for German language courses to help you immerse yourself in the local culture.

- A sociable working environment with an open, international culture.

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

An overview of this role

Why this role exists 

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. - Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.

- Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

- Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

Strongly preferred qualifications

Technologies and domains

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted B2B data layer powering modern revenue teams and AI-driven workflows alike. Today, more than 5,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

About the Role: 

At the heart of FullEnrich is our waterfall engine. It's the system responsible for deciding which data providers to call, in what order, under which conditions, and what happens when something fails. It works well today, but what we're building next is significantly more ambitious.

We're evolving the engine to become far more flexible and configurable, supporting account-specific requirements, dynamic routing based on different optimization goals, and seamless integration of new providers and behaviors without introducing unnecessary complexity.

This is a foundational part of our product, and getting the architecture right is critical to how we scale.

We're looking for an experienced Backend Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and taking ownership of the systems behind them.

If you've built high-throughput routing systems, designed multi-provider orchestration layers, or worked on infrastructure that needs to adapt to different customers and use cases, this is exactly the kind of challenge you'll be taking on.

What You'll Do: 

- Own and evolve our core routing engine: Take ownership of provider selection, fallback logic, load balancing, and queue management. Our waterfall currently operates as a modular Go monolith, and you'll help evolve it to support account-level customization at scale without introducing unnecessary complexity.

- Build and improve provider integrations: Design how we connect to and manage third-party data providers, focusing on rate limiting, reliability, and observability. This includes supporting external provider credentials, configurable provider ordering, and well-defined fallback behavior when providers are unavailable.

- Develop intelligent routing capabilities: Build the logic that dynamically selects providers based on different optimization objectives, including speed, coverage, compliance, and intelligent load balancing, while managing rate limits effectively.

- Design scalable multi-tenant architecture: Develop the foundations for sub-accounts, customer-specific credit pools, and endpoint-level configuration, ensuring the engine remains flexible, scalable, and maintainable.

- Build composable verification workflows: Integrate validity and compliance checks into the enrichment pipeline as configurable steps, allowing results to be independently verified regardless of their original data source.

- Strengthen our core architecture: Improve and refactor existing systems as we scale, applying strong engineering practices to keep our codebase clean, understandable, reliable, and easy to maintain.

- Shape technical decisions: Work closely with our engineering leadership to translate product requirements into thoughtful architectural solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalability.

What Success Looks Like 

In your first 3 months: 

- Develop a deep understanding of our existing waterfall engine, provider integrations, and core backend architecture.

- Build strong relationships with the engineering team and identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability.

- Start contributing to the evolution of our routing engine, taking ownership of initial architectural improvements and technical decisions.

By 6 months: 

- Take ownership of key components of our core platform, delivering meaningful improvements to provider orchestration, fallback logic, and routing capabilities.

- Help introduce more flexible, account-level configuration while keeping the architecture clean, scalable, and maintainable.

- Improve the reliability and observability of our provider integrations, reducing operational complexity as we scale.

By 12 months: 

- Play a leading role in delivering a more intelligent, configurable waterfall engine that supports different customer needs and optimization goals at scale.

- Establish robust architectural foundations for multi-tenancy, composable verification, and continued provider expansion.

- Be a trusted technical contributor within the engineering team, helping shape long-term architectural decisions and ensuring our core platform remains reliable, performant, and ready for future growth.

What We're Looking For: 

- Strong backend engineering experience: You've built and maintained production systems involving routing, fallback mechanisms, queues, concurrency, and rate limiting. You understand how distributed and multi-provider systems behave under pressure and how to design for reliability.

- An architecture-first mindset: You're comfortable taking a product requirement, identifying potential structural challenges, and designing solutions that will stand the test of time. You think beyond implementation and consider scalability, maintainability, and long-term impact.

- Deep experience with Golang: Go is at the core of our backend. You're confident working with modular architectures, clean code principles, and ideally hexagonal architecture.

- Experience managing technical complexity: You can navigate systems with multiple interconnected components, from account-level configuration and provider orchestration to compliance workflows and multi-tenancy, without compromising clarity or simplicity.

- Strong ownership and problem-solving skills: You're proactive, pragmatic, and comfortable making technical decisions. You enjoy getting into the details, understanding why systems behave the way they do, and finding solutions to challenging engineering problems.

- A collaborative approach: You communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and enjoy working with other engineers to build reliable, high-quality systems.

Nice to Have 

- Experience with data routing, enrichment pipelines, or multi-provider orchestration systems.

- Experience building API marketplace infrastructure or multi-tenant SaaS backends.

- Familiarity with API-first product architectures.

- An interest in the evolving data infrastructure landscape.

Our Tech Stack 

Our backend is built primarily in Golang , following a modular, hexagonal architecture.

Our wider stack includes:

- Backend: Go (Golang)

- Databases & Search: PostgreSQL, OpenSearch

- Infrastructure: DigitalOcean, Docker

- CI/CD: GitHub Actions

- Monitoring & Observability: Grafana

You'll be joining an engineering team of around 10 people, working on one of the most critical components of our platform.

Interview Process 

We aim to keep our process straightforward, transparent, and focused on getting to know each other.

- Introduction to FullEnrich with our Talent team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

- CTO & VP Engineering Interview (60 minutes): A conversation about your experience, the role, and a technical discussion based on a real experiment.

- Technical Assessment: A take-home exercise completed in your own time, followed by a review and discussion.

- Team & Culture Interview: Meet with a member of the team to learn more about how we work together and ensure there's a strong mutual fit.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Game Engine)
description:
About the Role 

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a newly forming team that will own one of the most specialised and business-critical domains in our technology landscape - Game Engine.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, game mathematics, platform, and compliance. You’ll work on the tools, frameworks, and services that enable our mathematicians and game teams to build, validate, run, and monitor game logic in production.

This position is about deep ownership of a very specific technical domain: game engines, mathematical packages, simulation data, RTP monitoring, round details, and integrations with games developed both internally and by external studios.

You’ll be part of a small, experienced team with a high level of responsibility. The impact of this work is direct: incorrect game logic, missing round details, or inaccurate RTP monitoring can affect game delivery timelines, business performance, and regulatory readiness.

If you enjoy working close to complex domain logic, reviewing technical implementations, understanding how games work under the hood, and owning systems where precision matters - this role will feel like home.

Key Responsibilities 

- Own, maintain, and evolve Playson’s Game Engine domain

- Work on internal frameworks and libraries used by mathematicians to implement game logic and mathematical packages.

- Review and validate code written by mathematicians, ensuring quality, correctness, maintainability, and proper usage of internal frameworks.

- Contribute to the development and support of game engines used to run mathematical logic within our platform.

- Support integrations with external game studios by helping build wrappers and bridges between third-party game implementations and Playson’s platform.

- Work with data structures and protocols that connect game logic with frontend and backend systems.

- Contribute to RTP monitoring processes, including validation of production transaction data against simulation data and expected mathematical behaviour.

- Support and evolve tools used for mathematical review, simulations, data files, monitoring, and alerting.

- Implement and maintain round details logic required for regulated markets, ensuring that detailed game round information can be correctly provided to partners and regulators.

- Collaborate closely with mathematicians, backend engineers, platform teams, compliance stakeholders, and product representatives.

- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions to ensure a high engineering standard across the Game Engine domain.

- Investigate issues related to game logic, mathematical validation, monitoring, and engine behaviour.

- Participate in minimal on-call responsibilities related to the systems owned by the team, mainly around monitoring, alerts, and domain-specific incidents.

- Take ownership of a highly specialised area where quality, accuracy, and attention to detail are essential.

Requirements 

- Strong software engineering experience, ideally in backend, game engine, gaming, gambling, betting, or simulation-heavy environments.

- Solid experience with Node.js/TypeScript, or strong expertise in another OOP language such as C++, Java, C#, Go, or Python.

- Good understanding of software architecture, code quality, testing, debugging, and maintainability.

- Experience reviewing complex code and providing clear technical feedback.

- Ability to understand domain-specific logic and work with technical systems where business rules, mathematics, and engineering are closely connected.

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work with complex, non-standard technical challenges.

- Experience working with production systems where reliability, accuracy, and correctness are critical.

- Understanding of backend systems, APIs, data flows, and service-to-service communication.

- Ability to collaborate closely with non-engineering technical experts, especially mathematicians or domain specialists.

- Strong ownership mindset and willingness to become a key expert in a narrow but highly important technical domain.

- Product-oriented thinking, with an understanding that games are the core product and engineering decisions directly affect delivery, quality, and compliance.

- English communication skills sufficient for working in an international environment.

Nice to Have 

- Experience in iGaming, gambling, betting, game development, or casino games.

- Experience working with game engines, mathematical engines, simulation tools, or game logic frameworks.

- Background in C++ or experience working with legacy C++ systems.

- Experience with mathematical models, probability-based systems, simulations, random generators, or RTP-related logic.

- Understanding of regulated markets and compliance requirements in iGaming.

- Experience with ClickHouse or other analytical/columnar databases.

- Experience with monitoring, alerting, and production diagnostics.

- Experience with AI-assisted code review or automated validation tools.

- Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems.

- Familiarity with Kafka, gRPC, Kubernetes, or AWS.

- Experience integrating third-party games, external studio products, or wrapper-based solutions.

- Ukrainian language skills would be a plus.

What We Offer

- Quarterly Bonuses: Benefit from a transparent and systematic quarterly bonus system

- Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible work schedule to accommodate your needs

- Remote Work Option: Choose to work remotely, providing greater flexibility and comfort

title: Cloud Systems Administrator
description:
Headquarters: 

URL: https://oneimaging.com 

Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration of our SaaS and cloud vendor stack, with security and logging as the first priority. You will manage user access across every platform we use, keep audit logging and security controls configured and reviewed, write scripts to automate repetitive admin work, and act as a first responder on security incidents. You will also provide hands-on IT support to employees. This is a generalist role for someone who likes owning systems end to end: you are the person who knows how each vendor is set up, who has access to what, and where the logs live. 

What you'll do: 

Vendor and SaaS administration (security and logging first) 

- Serve as the primary administrator for our SaaS and cloud platforms: tenant settings, SSO/SAML and SCIM integration, MFA enforcement, API keys, roles and permissions.

- Configure and maintain audit logging on every platform that supports it; centralize logs where possible and make sure retention meets our compliance needs.

- Run periodic access reviews, remove stale accounts and over-privileged roles, and keep an accurate inventory of who has admin rights where.

- Own the security posture of each vendor: review security settings on new tools before rollout, track vendor security notices, and evaluate new vendor requests for risk.

User lifecycle and identity

- Onboard and offboard employees and contractors across all systems the same day, driven from Rippling and Google Workspace, our identity sources of truth.

- Manage groups, roles and licenses; keep license counts right-sized and flag waste.

- Maintain device enrollment, MDM policies and endpoint security for company laptops.

Scripting and automation

- Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use vendor APIs to automate provisioning, access reviews, log collection and reporting.

- Build lightweight integrations between systems (for example, HRIS to identity provider to SaaS) so manual admin work shrinks over time.

Security incident response

- Act as a first responder on security alerts: triage, contain (disable accounts, revoke tokens, isolate devices), gather evidence from logs, and escalate.

- Participate in post-incident reviews and implement the fixes that come out of them.

- Help maintain and test our incident response and business continuity runbooks.

IT support

- Provide tier 1–2 support to employees: hardware, accounts, access, video conferencing, printers and office network.

- Procure, image and manage laptops and peripherals; keep an asset inventory current.

- Write and keep up internal how-to documentation so common requests become self-service.

Platforms you will administer

These are our largest software and cloud vendors by spend over the last 12 months. Deep experience with the first group is expected; the rest you will pick up on the job.

Area

Platforms

Cloud infrastructure

Amazon Web Services (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub)

Identity, HR and devices

Rippling (HRIS, SSO, device management) and Google Workspace, used together as our identity source of truth

Productivity and email

Google Workspace (admin console, Vault, security center)

Customer support and CRM

Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom

Communications

Zoom, Aircall, Twilio

Data and engineering

Databricks, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Linear, Postman, Stytch

AI platforms

Anthropic, OpenAI (API key and usage management)

Collaboration and design

Notion, Lucid, Figma, Adobe, Scribe

Security tools

NordVPN Teams, Virtru (email encryption)

Healthcare operations

Waystar, AdvancedMD

Marketing and recruiting

Braze, ActiveCampaign, Greenhouse, LinkedIn

About you: 

- 3+ years administering SaaS and cloud platforms in a company of 50–500 people, including Google Workspace and an identity/HR platform like Rippling or Okta, and ideally AWS.

- Hands-on experience configuring SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, MFA policies and role-based access.

- Working knowledge of audit logging and log review: you know what a CloudTrail event, a Workspace audit log or a Zendesk audit entry looks like and what to do with it.

- Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell or Bash, and comfort calling REST APIs.

- Experience responding to security incidents (phishing, compromised accounts, lost devices) and documenting what happened.

- Strong IT support instincts: you communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues and close tickets fast.

- Familiarity with HIPAA or a comparable compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and what it means for access control and logging.

Nice to have:

- AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Security Specialty, or Google Workspace Administrator certification.

- Experience with a SIEM or log aggregation tool (Datadog, Splunk, Google SecOps, or similar) and writing detection rules.

- MDM experience (Rippling, Jamf, Kandji, Intune) and macOS/Windows endpoint hardening.

- Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for managing AWS and SaaS configuration.

- Prior work in a healthcare or other regulated company.

- Experience administering API usage and keys for AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI) and setting spend and access controls.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic AI
description:
PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit. 

The role 

Most AI agents are demos. Ours answer the phone for some of the biggest brands in the world: more than 100 million calls a year, across 2,000+ live deployments. Someone is on the line trying to move a booking, report a fault or pay a bill, and the agent either works or it doesn't. 

We looking for a Forward Deployment Engineer who has built and shipped LLM agents in production, including tool use and evals. Forward Deployed Engineers are the people who make it work. You own a customer's agents from the first scoping call through to production and beyond. You design how the agent behaves, write the code that connects it to the customer's systems, put it on their phone lines, measure it and keep making it better. 

This is not sales engineering and it is not support. You ship code that runs in production, and you own what happens after it ships. 

We want someone who already builds agents because they can't help it, and who wants to do it at the hard end: real-time voice, messy enterprise systems, and callers who notice every mistake. 

What you'll do 

- Own agents in production, end to end. Scope with the customer; design the conversation, the tools and the guardrails; build in Agent Studio and our ADK; launch; and stay accountable for how it performs. 

- You have built and shipped LLM agents in production, including tool use and evals 

- Connect agents to the real world. Integrate CRMs, booking engines, payment flows and twenty-year-old APIs in Python. Work across SIP, telephony and contact-centre platforms. Make tool calls fast and reliable in the middle of a live conversation. 

- Debug live calls. When a call goes wrong, work out whether it was the speech recognition, the model, the prompt, an integration or the phone line, and fix the right thing. 

- Run agents like a scientist. Build eval sets from real calls, run A/B tests and let data decide what ships. Containment, resolution and caller experience are your numbers. 

- Close the gap to the platform. When you solve something for one customer, turn it into a reusable tool, template or product change so the next deployment is faster. Work directly with product, research and platform engineering, including the team training Raven, our own LLM built for customer service. 

- Be the technical lead the customer trusts. Run sessions with their engineering, operations and executive teams. Explain trade-offs plainly. Say no when no is the right answer.

To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. 🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. 💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

- Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

- Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

- Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

- Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374 

- Our site selection agent : an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

- Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

- You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

- Python proficiency

- Strong problem-solving skills

- Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

- Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

- Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

- Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

- ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured. 

- Researchers who moved into production. 

- Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

- your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

- you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

In this versatile role, you’ll not only own all analytics around our GMV reporting, but also play a key part in shaping the underlying processes and data flows. - Leadership: You lead and develop a high-performing team specializing in revenue analysis, finance operations and analytics. 

What you bring: 

- You have at least five years of experience in an analytical, process-driven field under your belt, ideally in finance. 

- You love data. You don’t just read numbers; you can interpret them, put them in context and translate them into concrete recommendations. 

- You’ve already successfully demonstrated your leadership skills and have previously worked as a team lead. 

- You’re known for working with great precision and have the drive to proactively push change within the company. 

- You spot problems early, structure them, abstract from individual cases and develop sound solutions, which you document clearly, align with stakeholders and implement consistently. 

- You proactively take ownership and are excited to help build processes and structures from the ground up. 

- You have experience with modern BI and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau or comparable solutions). 

- Ideally, you have scripting and coding skills (Python, Google Apps Script) and are keen to apply AI and automation in a targeted way in finance.

- We offer hybrid work models or 100% remote options (depending on the role). This position is hybrid, based in Munich (50% in-office / 50% remote).

- If you work 100% remotely, we provide ergonomic home office equipment (after your probation period). 

- You will be provided with brand-new IT equipment, including a MacBook, keyboard, and mouse.

- Receive a 10% discount on personal travel booked via the L&P platform.

- Receive an additional €30 allowance toward a benefit of your choice: Deutschlandticket, Wellpass, Jobrad (bike leasing), capital-forming benefits (VL), or company pension scheme (after your probation period).

description:

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform delivers a fully managed, multi-cloud Postgres service designed for the most demanding production workloads. We handle the complexity of provisioning, scaling, replication, and failover - so engineering teams can focus on building their products.

Our customers entrust us with their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Postgres engineering team and help us build a world-class managed Postgres offering.

What's the job to be done?

- You will design and build the control plane that provisions, scales, and heals Postgres clusters with minimal customer-visible downtime.

- You will build and maintain high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection solutions that keep customer databases safe through infrastructure failures.

- You will tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the world.

- You will build tooling and automation for database operations, backup, restore, and migration workflows - and participate in an on-call rotation.

- You will work directly with customers to understand their workloads and translate real-world needs into platform improvements.

These attributes best describe you…

- You have strong experience building, operating, or maintaining large-scale Postgres deployments in production.

- You have an excellent understanding of low-level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, and performance.

- You have strong fundamental computer science skills and can reason about distributed, fault-tolerant systems.

- You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy mentoring other engineers, and communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly.

- You are self-motivated and can work independently with minimal guidance while making sound technical decisions.

What you will need

- 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

- Strong proficiency in Go, with experience in other languages like Ruby, Python, Zig or Rust.

- Experience building and maintaining distributed, fault-tolerant services.

- Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized applications.

- Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.

What else will help you be successful

- Experience building or operating a database-as-a-service or managed database platform.

- Experience with connection pooling and proxy layers for Postgres.

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure-as-code.

- Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Postgres or database infrastructure space.

- Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams.

- Previous experience at a high-growth technology company.

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. title: Product Analyst (Mid and Senior Level) - Joint Account
description:
Our Story 

Hello there. We’re Zopa. 

We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com ! 

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

At Zopa, analysts are the people who inspire ideas and strategies to drive our business forward and make our products better for customers. Our analysts are a mix of creative problem solvers and number whizzes with a passion for translating data into business opportunities and delivering insights to drive decision-making. They're also excellent communicators with the ability to story-tell with data to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Our analysts are deeply embedded into the business and will interact with individuals at every level, from managers to our leadership team.

The role 

We’re looking for a Product Analyst to join our Joint Current Account team. 

You will be joining the team as they launch a new product that is fundamental to the bank’s future growth ambitions. We operate like a startup within the wider bank; we’re obsessive about our mission to build a powerfully simple to use and feature-rich everyday account that customers will love.

As a Product Analyst, you will develop a detailed understanding of who our customers are and how they use the account, guiding product development towards innovative features and experiences and owning customer outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to work in a fast-paced environment where you can have an outsized impact in the early stages of a new product. With so many decisions to inform, quick high conviction directional insights will sometimes be more valuable than achieving 100% precision with every analysis.

A day in the life 

- Partnering with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Analysts across Zopa, delivering trusted insights daily to inform decisions and improve the Joint Account product

- Designing and evaluating statistically rigorous experiments to support rapid iterative product development as we test our way through uncertainty

- Defining metrics that will be our source of truth for product performance, quality of user experience, and progress on key results

- Owning your analytics roadmap, proactively identifying opportunities for further analysis and prioritising the highest impact work

- Building at the cutting edge of AI-enabled analytics, developing new tools for natural language insight generation and powerful internal data apps

About you 

- Technical : Experience in an analytical role with strong data manipulation skills in SQL and/or Python. You’re comfortable getting stuck into large datasets and extracting insight that drives decision making 

- Delivery : You’ve worked in a fast-paced environment (e.g. fintech, start-up, consulting). You prioritise for impact and strike the right balance between precision and effort depending on the context 

- Clarity : You thrive in an environment with unstructured, open-ended problems. You’re able isolate signal from the noise and bring clarity to decision-makers 

- Influence : You communicate clearly and explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You’re not afraid to challenge where appropriate, but you always approach others with respect and sensitivity

- Motivation : You are self-starter with a bias to action who doesn’t wait to be told what to do. You’re excited about building innovative banking products 

Nice to have

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (PostgreSQL DBA)
description:
About Workato 

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com . 

Why join us? 

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles . We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care . That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you! 

Also, feel free to check out why: 

- Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on” 

- Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world 

- Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America 

- Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers 

Responsibilities 

As our PostgreSQL DBA, you will be the go-to engineer for everything data-layer: index and schema design on multi-terabyte tables, query optimization for application teams, connection pooling, upgrades, and migrations. Our PostgreSQL runs on Amazon Aurora — operating a large, fast-growing fleet consistently: turning one-off procedures into reliable automation, keeping dozens of clusters healthy at once, and helping developers use the database well. You'll split your time between a support rotation for incoming developer requests and longer-cycle reliability and automation projects.

In this role, y ou will also be responsible to: 

- 
Own day-to-day PostgreSQL operations across all production data centers: index creation on large/partitioned tables, query-plan analysis, schema reviews, data migrations.

- 
Partner with application teams on data-model decisions — design, partitioning, retention, consolidation vs. standalone clusters — and push back with data when a design won't scale.

- 
Operate and tune Aurora PostgreSQL: parameter groups, replicas, failover behavior, capacity planning.

- 
Run and evolve our PgBouncer connection-pooling layer.

- 
Turn manual runbooks into released, repeatable automation: seamless upgrade, switchover, database/user provisioning, grants management (Terraform + Ansible).

- 
Drive incident response and RCAs for database-related issues, and land the follow-up actions.

- 
Maintain and improve database observability (postgres_exporter, VictoriaMetrics dashboards and alerts).

- 
Take part in the team's duty rotation handling developer requests, with protected focus time off-duty.

Requirements 

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills 

- 
5+ years of hands-on operational PostgreSQL experience (DBA / database reliability role).

- 
Strong command of query plans, indexing strategy, and performance work on multi-TB tables.

- 
Production experience with managed PostgreSQL (Aurora or RDS) and a clear-eyed view of its constraints.

- 
Working proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices; comfortable in Linux.

- 
Experience with connection pooling (PgBouncer or similar) in production.

- 
Practical experience with logical replication, major-version upgrades, and low-downtime migration techniques.

- 
Scripting ability (Bash, Python or GO) and an automation-first mindset.

- 
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred); strong incident-management and RCA skills.

Nice to Haves 

- 
Operational exposure to ClickHouse, OpenSearch, or Redis/Valkey, Neo4j.

- 
Kubernetes fundamentals (our poolers, proxies, and exporters run on EKS).

- 
Experience with Vault, ArgoCD, or GitOps workflows.

- 
Comfort using AI coding assistants to accelerate routine analysis and tooling.

Tech Stack 

- 
AWS • Aurora PostgreSQL • Kubernetes • PgBouncer • Terraform • Ansible • VictoriaMetrics • Vault • Linux

title: Full Stack Engineer, AI systems
description:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer - AI Systems to build the product layer that turns these capabilities into usable, production-grade workflows. This includes designing how agents operate, fail, recover, and deliver consistent value to users.

Focus 

- Build end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, and AI integrations

- Design agent workflows that handle planning, tool use, failure, and recovery across multiple steps.

- Integrate LLMs, memory, and external tools into systems that behave reliably under real-world conditions

- Design real-time AI interactions with streaming, partial results, and tight latency constraints

- Improve system reliability, observability, and fallback mechanisms

- Collaborate closely with ML, backend, and product teams to ship features end-to-end

- Continuously iterate based on real usage and failure modes

Ideal Experiences 

- Strong experience in full stack engineering (frontend + backend)

- Solid understanding of system design and API architecture

- Experience working with LLMs, RAG systems, or AI-powered applications

- Ability to handle ambiguity and make pragmatic engineering decisions

- Strong ownership - able to take features from idea to production

- Comfort working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements

Outcomes 

- Own and ship AI-native product features that move beyond chat into persistent, goal-driven workflows

- Design and deploy agent workflows that reliably complete multi-step tasks across tools and sessions

- Reduce latency and improve responsiveness of AI interactions while maintaining output quality

- Build robust fallback and recovery mechanisms for LLM and tool failures in production environments

- Improve the success rate and reliability of AI-driven workflows through iteration, evaluation, and monitoring

- Establish patterns and abstractions for integrating LLMs, memory, and external tools into scalable product systems

- Contribute to a product experience where AI feels proactive, consistent, and dependable over time

Tech Stack 

- Next.js

- Python

- NodeJs

- Pytorch

- OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLMs

- SQl & noSQL

- Kubernetes

- Docker

How We Work 

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process 

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Confirmed Backend Engineer - Care
description:
About BlaBlaCar 

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.

We are looking for a Confirmed Backend Engineer to join the Care team at BlaBlaCar.

As part of the Corporate Services pillar, your mission will be to empower our Community Relations Team (CRT) with the tools they need to have a 360-degree view of the user journey across our platform. 

The Care team's primary objective is to build "Phoenix," our new, comprehensive back-office system. This service aggregates data from all other teams and supply lines (train, carpool, and bus), while also providing critical action capabilities regarding our users, such as account blocking and content moderation. 

Your role will be to contribute to the creation of this unified back-office and to ensure our customer relation agents can operate seamlessly. 

You will work within a multi-stack team of 3 Backend & 1 Frontend Engineer. You will collaborate closely with the Community Relations Team (CRT) as well as with Product Managers from other teams to best define needs and ensure seamless integration across the company.

Your Responsibilities 

- 
Design, build, and evolve the services of the BlaBlaCar Backoffice

- 
Maintain some strategic user features like the claim management and reporting systems of the BlaBlaCar platform

- 
Take full ownership of substantial features, from technical design and implementation to deployment and monitoring

- 
Collaborate with the Product Manager and other engineers to refine requirements and translate business needs into robust technical solutions

- 
Uphold and improve the team's code quality standards, providing detailed feedback and mentorship through code reviews

- 
Document the solutions we build and ensure our APIs and services are well understood by consumer teams

Your Qualifications 

- 
You have solid experience from companies with a strong engineering culture, within a growth context

- 
You have a solid knowledge of the Java language and ecosystem, and have good foundations in software architecture

- 
You have hands-on experience with Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring solutions (Datadog)

- 
You have significant experience building, deploying, and operating Backend microservices in a production environment

- 
You value a product-oriented mindset and are focused on delivering business impact when designing software

- 
You feel comfortable making technical choices and balancing business needs with technical constraints

If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application!

- 
Hybrid position : 2 days at the office per week 

- 
50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

- 
4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

- 
Financial support for home office equipment

- 
Minimum 25 days holiday per year 

- 
Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

- 
50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

- 
Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

- 
Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs

- 
Employee Stock ownership plan

- 
Regular team building events

1 day off per year to test our product

a 60-min design interview with Software Engineers

title: Senior Gen AI Software Engineer
description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Join Liftoff as a Senior Gen AI Software Engineer and help shape the future of ad tech. As a key member of our Gen AI team, you’ll design and build AI-powered products for our demand-side business, helping teams turn complex data into better decisions and meaningful customer growth.

You’ll work across the stack, building intelligent systems and data pipelines in Python, alongside the TypeScript and React experiences that bring those capabilities to users. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to identify high-impact opportunities, move quickly from prototype to production, and continuously improve what you ship.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of AI, product, and software engineering. You’ll help define how Liftoff applies modern AI to real business problems, balancing experimentation with the judgment and engineering discipline needed to build useful, reliable products.

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys experimenting with new technology, and is motivated by turning promising AI capabilities into products that create real value. You’ll tackle complex problems, validate new approaches, and drive meaningful improvements across Liftoff.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Own generative AI product capabilities end to end, from understanding user workflows and prototyping an approach through implementation, rollout, measurement, and ongoing improvement.

- Rapidly prototype and validate AI solutions, using focused experiments to test user value and technical feasibility, then turn what works into production-ready capabilities.

- Build agentic workflows that can reason over campaign, customer, creative, and performance data, use well-defined tools, produce structured results, and hand control back to a person when appropriate.

- Partner closely with decision makers and subject matter experts to understand their workflows, constraints, and business context, then integrate AI agents into daily work in practical and useful ways.

- Design how AI systems access and use relevant information, including the data, tools, and instructions needed to produce useful grounded results.

- Build the systems that make AI workflows reliable in production, including tool use, state management, failure recovery, and appropriate boundaries for human review.

- Define clear, testable interfaces between models and software so uncertain model behavior can be handled safely within dependable product systems.

- Develop evaluation systems that measure whether AI features accomplish the intended task, using realistic examples and an appropriate combination of automated checks and human judgment.

- Build the instrumentation needed to understand quality, adoption, business impact, latency, cost, and failure modes in production.

- Apply appropriate safeguards for customer data, system access, and high-impact workflows.

- Build the Python services and TypeScript and React interfaces that turn these capabilities into cohesive products for customer facing teams.

- Evaluate new models and techniques pragmatically, adopting them when they materially improve product quality, capability, speed, or cost.

- Mentor other engineers and help establish shared practices for designing, testing, and operating AI-powered products.

WHO YOU ARE 

- Minimum Bachelors Degree and 8 yrs of relevant experience.

- You are a seasoned software engineer who has built and operated meaningful production products, ideally including zero-to-one work spanning backend services, data, and user interfaces.

- You have shipped LLM-powered or AI-assisted products beyond a demo and understand the practical challenges of reliability, context, tool use, provider changes, latency, cost, and changing model behavior.

- You are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working in TypeScript and React, with strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, SQL, and testing.

- You understand how to build the broader system around a model, including its data, tools, instructions, permissions, feedback loops, and measures of quality.

- You can define success criteria, investigate failures, and use testing, feedback, and production signals to improve AI experiences over time.

- You exercise strong product and engineering judgment, choosing when a problem calls for traditional software, an LLM-powered approach, or a thoughtful combination of both.

- You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with domain experts and non-technical partners.

- You are comfortable working through ambiguity, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and changing direction when evidence shows a better path.

- You are a lifelong learner with strong but flexible opinions, and you thrive on giving and receiving constructive feedback.

Helpful, but not required

- Experience as an early engineer, startup founder, or in a similarly high-ownership environment where you moved quickly from ambiguous problems to shipped products.

- Experience with advertising technology, campaign optimization, performance marketing, analytics products, or other data-rich B2B software.

Location: 

The preferred location for the role is in Pacific Standard Time Zone. This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Firmus Technologies 

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. 

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud 

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE 

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Principal Data Engineer to join our Engineering and Technology team. You will own the data architecture across the company, setting the standards, patterns, and technology choices our engineer s build on as we scale the platform. Your influence spans the full data stack: streaming telemetry off GPU compute and cooling systems, the data lake feeding hardware failure prediction models, the AI-native layers powering agent-based workflows, and the governance layer that keeps it all secure, discoverable, and compliant. You will be one of the most senior technical voices for data at Firmus: you make the architecture decisions the organisation lives with long-term, and you stay hands-on on the problems that are too complex or too consequential to delegate. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Data Architecture & Technology Strategy 

Own the data architecture across Firmus: the patterns, technology choices, and technical standards that teams build on. Make the build-versus-buy, storage-topology, and streaming-versus-batch decisions the organisation lives with long-term and own the outcomes they lead to. 

- Platform Build & Operations 

Build the core of the data platform hands-on: the real-time and AI data pipelines, the storage layer, and the transformation and semantic layers that serve BI tooling, internal analytics, and customer-facing reporting. Collaborate with the data engineers and platform engineers to deliver and operate streaming and batch ingestion from GPU telemetry, cooling sensors, billing, and incident sources, with clear reliability, schema-evolution, and latency SLAs. Data components run as infrastructure-as-code on the self-hosted, bare-metal Kubernetes. You own their deployment, quality, and storage cost, and work with platform engineers on backup, recovery, and incident response. 

- Governance, Quality & Compliance 

Define and enforce data contracts, lineage, and access control across teams. Set organisation-wide data quality and observability standards: schema contract enforcement, freshness SLAs, and anomaly detection. Extend Firmus' existing SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 controls to the data platform as it scales into new data centres and meet the regulatory requirements that apply to our enterprise and government customers. 

- Technical Leadership 

Raise the standard of data engineering in Firmus. Run design and architecture reviews, drive the RFC process, and catch architectural problems before they reach production. Mentor engineers on data architecture, data quality, and operational practice, building capability rather than a dependency on you. 

- Stakeholder & Customer Interface 

Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to the CTO and engineering leadership, direct about risks and clear about recommendations. Partner with the AI and application team so the architecture supports AI agent workflows and hardware failure prediction. Engage enterprise and government customers on architecture, lineage, or compliance when the conversation needs a senior technical voice. 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field. 

- 10+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 5 years making platform-level decisions that other teams depended on. You are still hands-on and intend to stay that way. 

- You have been the most senior data engineer or architect in an organisation before, owning the architecture rather than contributing to it. 

- Deep, hands-on knowledge of end-to-end data architecture: ingestion, storage patterns, transformation, semantic layer design, observability, and governance. 

- Track record designing large-scale data platforms that integrate data across multiple regions or data centres. 

- Production experience operating high-cardinality time-series and telemetry pipelines at high ingest and update rates. 

- Production experience across columnar, time-series, relational, object, and vector storage patterns. You know when to use each one and what it costs to operate . 

- Hands-on experience with event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka for extremely high-throughput, low-latency ingestion. 

- Hands-on experience with both managed data platforms (such as Databricks or Snowflake) and their self-hosted, open-source equivalents (such as Spark, Trino, ClickHouse , and lake house table formats like Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg). 

- Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark. 

- Experience with pipeline orchestration and transformation tooling such as Airflow and dbt , with data quality testing built into standard pipeline development. 

- Kubernetes experience covering Helm-based deployments and operation of stateful data workloads on self-hosted, bare-metal infrastructure. 

- Experience delivering data governance programmes against compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001, not just awareness of them. 

- Experience running architectural reviews and setting engineering standards across teams. 

- Willing to take part in the incident-response on-call rotation for the services your team owns. 

- Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it. 

- Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English. You can explain a complex architectural decision to a CTO or customer without losing the substance. 

Preferred Experiences: 

- Background in AI infrastructure, GPU cloud, or high-performance compute, particularly working with infrastructure telemetry data at scale. 

- Experience with industrial IoT and OT telemetry pipelines. 

- Production experience with vector databases and embedding or retrieval pipelines for LLM and AI-agent use cases such as failure prediction and incident response. 

Location: Singapore 

Employment Basis 

Full-time

Diversity 

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

title: Director, GTM AI Engineering
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role: 

Samsara’s Machine Learning, AI, Analytics & Data (MAAD) team builds the intelligence and technology that helps our go-to-market teams work faster, make better decisions, and spend more time with customers.

As the Director, GTM AI Engineering you’ll run our AI Engineering team for GTM. You’ll work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering to serve Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, and GTM leadership. This is a hands-on Director role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building (prototyping agents, writing code, designing evals) and about 30% leading the team, setting strategy, and influencing stakeholders.

You’ll build intelligent workflow experiences. That ranges from AI agents and copilots that take manual work off sellers’ plates, to signals for propensity and prioritization, to the data, evaluation, and measurement foundations that make these products reliable and trusted.

The ideal candidate is AI-native. You already run your own work through agents every day, you’ve shipped AI products to production, and you get as excited about a seller’s first “wow, this saved me an hour” moment as you do about a clean architecture.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will: 

- Build hands-on. Prototype, ship, and iterate on AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations for GTM teams, from the first demo to a production system people rely on.

- Build the platform, not just the apps. Own the architecture of the shared GTM AI platform: orchestration, LLM and tool gateways, identity and access, and the MCP and SDK contracts that let the GTM web app, Salesforce, Slack, desktop, and Claude plugins share one set of governed capabilities.

- Make evals a first-class discipline. Design evaluation frameworks for agent and LLM behavior, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops, and regression suites, and run them in development and production. Use transcript analysis and eval results to find failures, guide what to fix first, and show quality improving over time.

- Lead with AI day to day. Use agents, coding assistants, and agent harnesses in your own daily work, and build the shared tooling, patterns, and harnesses that make the whole team faster.

- Stay ahead of the curve. Track new models, agent frameworks, MCP and tool ecosystems, and context engineering, and turn them into practical recommendations for Samsara's GTM use cases: what to adopt, what to test, and what to ignore. Make clear build-versus-buy calls on vendor tools, not just models.

- Drive adoption with the field. Be the go-to advocate for AI across Sales, CS, and Support. Run demos, earn credibility with reps and frontline managers, collect real feedback, and turn skeptics into power users.

- Set the strategy. Own the technical and product strategy for GTM AI, including the data foundations, instrumentation, governance, and observability these products depend on. Decide which prototypes move onto the shared platform, which merge, and which retire. Own model routing across vendors and the per-user spend controls that keep AI cost in line with value. Influence senior leaders on AI priorities, investment, and the operating model.

- Ship revenue-critical intelligence. Own the forecasting, propensity, and CRM data-quality work that sales leadership acts on, and keep it calibrated, validated, and clear about its limits. Be comfortable across data and analytics engineering, and act as a business leader when the work calls for it.

- Partner across GTM, Product, and Engineering. Work with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders to find high-value opportunities, define success metrics, and turn them into durable products.

- Build for trust. Put a pragmatic responsible-AI approach in place: safety, privacy, reliability, and human-in-the-loop workflows with clear approval and escalation paths. Agents that act on CRM and customer data run with per-user, least-privilege permissions, and changes to systems of record get human approval first.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

- Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing AI Engineering team

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 10+ years across software engineering, machine learning, data science, or data platforms, including meaningful leadership experience. You still write code regularly.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.

- Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, context engineering, and production reliability.

- Production full-stack and cloud engineering experience (for example Python or TypeScript, AWS, and Databricks), including owning systems that other teams depend on.

- Demonstrated experience designing and running evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent systems, and using them to drive quality decisions.

- Daily, fluent use of AI agents and coding assistants in your own work, and a point of view on how they change the way teams build.

- A track record of shipping internal or customer-facing AI/ML products with measurable business impact.

- Experience with predictive modeling, experimentation, analytics, and data engineering foundations.

- Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into simple, valuable solutions.

- Excellent communication with both executives and frontline users. You can demo to a sales floor and present to a VP on the same day.

- A people-first leadership style with a track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong technical talent.
