title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place. 

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel. 

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data.

With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe.

Your itinerary 

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day. 

- Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps.

- Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data).

- Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs.

- Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership.

- Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal

- Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders.

- Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics.

- Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth.

- Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting.

- Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales.

The equipment in your backpack 

What we're hoping you'll bring with you. 

✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company.

✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster.

✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

- You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

- You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

- You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

- Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts

- Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident

- Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives

- Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

- Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response

- Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal

- Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara’s investigation processes, with proficiency in Python

- Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis

- Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams

- Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux

- Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews

- Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services

- Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.

- This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has: 

- 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience

- GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification

- Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.

At the heart of our offering is a versatile software platform for orchestrating complex robotic systems. It allows efficient customization for specific customer requirements: configuring systems, developing reusable skills, parameterizing processes, and executing tasks reliably in production. Learned models — from perception to end-to-end policies — are a core part of this platform.

Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission.

We are looking for a passionate Forward Deployed AI Engineer to bring state-of-the-art robot learning and computer vision models into real production environments. In this role, you will train, fine-tune, and deploy AI models directly on customer robots — from Vision-Language-Action models and diffusion policies to perception and grasp generation networks. You will become a trusted technical partner, turning customer challenges into robust, data-driven robotics applications. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

- Deploy, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models on real robotic systems at customer sites — including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, diffusion policies, and other end-to-end learned policies

- Adapt and train perception models for robotic applications, e.g. object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation based on YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones such as DINOv2

- Integrate and tune grasp generation models (e.g., GraspNet, Dex-Net, Contact-GraspNet) for bin picking and manipulation tasks

- Build data pipelines for customer deployments: demonstration and teleoperation recording, dataset curation, annotation, training runs, and systematic evaluation of model performance

- Bring models into production: optimize inference, deploy on edge and embedded hardware, and integrate models into our robotic software platform

- Work closely with customers to understand technical requirements and translate them into robust, AI-driven robotics applications

- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve model, software, and system integration issues both remotely and on-site

- Travel to international customer sites for workshops, deployments, training, and technical support (up to 40% travel)

Essential Skills

- Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

- Minimum of four years of professional experience in machine learning, AI for robotics, or computer vision

- Hands-on experience working with real robots — robot arms, mobile manipulators, grippers, cameras, and sensors — not only in simulation

- Proven experience with end-to-end learned models for robotics (e.g., VLAs, diffusion policies, imitation or reinforcement learning policies), covering training, fine-tuning, and deployment

- Strong programming skills in both Python and C++

- Solid command of machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and the full model lifecycle: data curation, training, evaluation, and deployment

- Experience with modern computer vision models such as YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones (e.g., DINOv2, CLIP)

- Experience with learned grasp generation for manipulation (e.g., GraspNet, Dex-Net, or comparable approaches)

- Good understanding of robot (inverse) kinematics, coordinate transformations, and hand-eye calibration

- Experience working in Linux environments

- Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in customer environments

- Fluency in English

Beneficial Skills

- Experience with large-scale demonstration data collection, teleoperation setups, and sim-to-real transfer

- Experience with robot learning simulation frameworks (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo)

- Good understanding of classical computer vision (e.g., OpenCV, PCL, camera calibration, point cloud processing)

- Experience optimizing inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX, quantization) and deploying on NVIDIA embedded platforms (e.g., Jetson Orin, AGX, Xavier)

- Experience with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and continuous training or evaluation pipelines

- Publications or open-source contributions in robot learning, manipulation, or computer vision

- Familiarity with industrial automation environments (e.g., PLCs, EtherCAT, OPC UA)

What we offer 

- 
A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.

- 
Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.

- 
Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.

- 
Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.

- 
Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.

- 
Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us 

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry.

Biobase | Senior Technical Product Engineer, Technical Product Engineer (Early Career) | REMOTE (US, Canada) | Full-time | $150–230k / $90–170k + equity Biobase has grand ambitions. We broker biospecimens, whole slide images, and the clinical metadata attached to them, on a supply-chain backbone that we're steadily automating. We’re building healthcare-data-focused agents on top of the datasets that we’re assembling, too. We'd rather build the thing that removes the work than throw people at it. Two roles, one team, both reporting to the CPO: Senior Technical Product Engineer ($150–230k + meaningful equity).
The product team's technical interface. Architecture decisions and code review on the platform (Python/FastAPI, TypeScript/React, Postgres, Azure); the data pipeline and informatics that take specimen, slide, and clinical data in from suppliers and labs; and product ownership of the internal platform that builds our agents (permissions, evals, cost control, guardrails for sensitive data). You've been the reviewer of record somewhere, you've operated what you shipped, and you think in business problems before tickets. Technical Product Engineer, early career ($90–170k + equity).
Same territory at an earlier stage: the platform, the data pipeline and informatics, and the agents we run against our own operations — with a senior product engineer and our lead engineer reviewing your work and pairing when it helps. Open on background – self-taught, bootcamp, degree, research lab, a career you're leaving – selective on the bar. You've built something and someone else used it. We build with Claude Code every day and expect you to become both fluent with it and skeptical of it. No ticket queue, no spec handed to you. Comp is salary + equity combos you choose between. Full postings: https://biobase.ai/careers To apply: email jobs@biobase.ai with something you built that eliminated manual work and what happened after it shipped. Links over resumes, no cover letter.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About us: 

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the role: 
We are looking for a platform engineer / developer experience engineer to improve the systems that help our engineering team move quickly and safely.

This is a hands-on role spanning build systems, CI, testing infrastructure, dependency and vulnerability management, and internal developer tooling. The engineer will combine operational ownership with deeper system improvement: keeping critical processes reliable while identifying and removing recurring sources of friction.

The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals, excellent debugging instincts, and a genuine interest in building tools and workflows for other engineers. They understand that an internal platform is a product: solutions must be reliable, ergonomic, well documented, and easy to adopt.

Candidates do not need prior ownership of every area in the role. We value broad engineering judgment, curiosity, and demonstrated interest in improving developer productivity over narrow specialization.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Owning and maintaining build systems, CI pipelines, testing infrastructure and internal tooling to keep engineering workflows reliable and efficient

- Helping and enabling other engineers by identifying recurring sources of friction and designing and implementing solutions to remove them

- Vulnerability and dependency management

- Reviewing code and contributing to a high standard of code quality and maintainability

You're a great fit if you: 

- Have 4+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer or Developer Experience Engineer

- Are proficient in at least two of the following: build systems, continuous integration, testing, observability, dependency and vulnerability management, release workflows or internal tooling

- Are comfortable working with Python tooling and packaging, including dependency management and the broader Python developer ecosystem

- Have a genuine interest in building tools and processes that help other engineers move faster

- Have strong software engineering fundamentals and excellent debugging instincts

- Bring broad engineering judgment and curiosity

- (Nice to have) Experience with tooling, packaging, and dependency management in JavaScript, Rust, Go or other language ecosystems

- (Nice to have) Experience working with Kubernetes, including deploying services and debugging running workloads

What you can look forward to: 

- Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site

- Collaborative and supportive work environment

- Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company

Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

title: Stage 2027  Business Data Scientist - Marketing effectivness
description:
Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability. 

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.

Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. 

Pourquoi recrutons-nous ? 

Pour accompagner notre forte croissance, nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e Stagiaire Data Scientist avec une appétence technique et marketing/stratégie.

Notre positionnement unique sur le marché vous permettra d’allier des compétences techniques telles que l’économétrie, l’économie, les statistiques et les mathématiques appliquées avec de la programmation. Il vous permettra également de développer des compétences en stratégie, conseil et marketing afin de répondre au mieux aux problématiques business de nos clients.

Votre rôle dans l’équipe : 

Votre rôle dans l’équipe : 

• Manipuler des bases de données, cleaning, avec l’utilisation d’outils adaptés  comme Python et/ou Excel. 

• Analyser des données et réaliser des modèles  d'économétrie, statistiques bayésienne etc. 

• Analyser et construire la stratégie marketing et optimisation media en s’appuyant sur les modèles 

• Participer également à la construction des livrables et à la présentation des recommandations à nos clients 

Profil recherché : 

• Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur généraliste ou d’une école de commerce.

• Vous avez de bonnes bases en programmation, ainsi qu'une expérience en Python et avec les modèles de data science. 

• Vous savez analyser des données et les transformer en recommandations stratégiques pour répondre aux enjeux business. 

• Votre curiosité, votre esprit analytique et votre aisance en communication vous permettent de collaborer efficacement avec différentes parties prenantes.

• Une expérience académique ou professionnelle sur Databricks/Azure est un plus.

Notre processus recrutement 

- Un test technique sur HackerRank

- Un entretien RH avec un(e) Talent Acquisition

- Une étude de cas

- Un entretien final 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu , que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte. 

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations. 

Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©.

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Aufgaben:

- Mit Ihrer Passion für moderne Software- und AI-Entwicklung wirken Sie in einem interdisziplinären Team an einer digitalen Plattform zur strukturierten Testbeschreibung im Prüfmittelentwicklungsprozess mit
- Sie entwickeln und erweitern eine Web-Plattform, die als zentrale Grundlage dient, um Tests zu beschreiben, zu generieren, zu parametrisieren sowie Limits, Messunsicherheiten und weitere prüfrelevante Informationen an Testprogramme zu übertragen
- Dabei bringen Sie Ihr tiefgreifendes Informatik-Know-how ein, um skalierbare, modulare und wartbare Softwarelösungen zu schaffen, die eng mit der bestehenden R&S-Infrastruktur gekoppelt sind
- Sie beschäftigen sich intensiv mit modernen AI-Technologien, insbesondere Large Language Models, Multi-Agenten-Systemen und aktuellen Modell-Benchmarks, und bewerten deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Kontext der Prüfmittelentwicklung
- Mit Ihrem Verständnis für Softwarearchitekturen und Entwicklungsprozesse tragen Sie dazu bei, AI-gestützte Workflows für die Erstellung, Verwaltung und Nutzung von Testbeschreibungen zu konzipieren und umzusetzen
- Sie unterstützen die Anbindung der Plattform an bestehende Systeme, insbesondere zur Archivierung der erzeugten Plattformdaten im PDM-Umfeld, z. B. für Process Associated Documents
- Gemeinsam mit Fachexperten aus Entwicklung, Fertigung, Prüfmittelentwicklung und IT analysieren Sie Anforderungen, überführen diese in tragfähige technische Konzepte und setzen diese in qualitativ hochwertige Softwarelösungen um
- Sie verifizieren die von Ihnen entwickelten Funktionen, begleiten deren Einführung in den operativen Einsatz und treiben die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Plattform proaktiv voran
- Je nach Erfahrung übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete, koordinieren technische Abstimmungen und begleiten die Übergabe neuer Funktionen an Anwender und Stakeholder

Qualifikationen:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, technischen Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Software Engineering oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Fundierte Programmierkenntnisse in modernen Softwaretechnologien, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in Web-Entwicklung, Backend-Services, APIs, Datenmodellen und Softwarearchitekturen
- Intensive praktische Auseinandersetzung mit AI-Entwicklung, insbesondere mit Large Language Models, Prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Agentic Workflows oder Multi-Agenten-Systemen
- Erfahrung in der Bewertung und Nutzung aktueller AI-Modelle und Benchmarks sowie die Fähigkeit, deren Stärken, Grenzen und Einsatzpotenziale für industrielle Entwicklungsprozesse einzuordnen
- Vorteilhaft sind Kenntnisse im Bereich Prüfmittelentwicklung, Testautomatisierung, Mess- und Prüftechnik oder in der Entwicklung von Testsystemen für elektronische Baugruppen und Geräte
- Verständnis für strukturierte Testbeschreibungen, Parametrisierung von Tests, Grenzwertdefinitionen, Messunsicherheiten oder vergleichbare technische Datenmodelle ist von Vorteil
- Erfahrung mit Datenmanagement, Dokumentenablage, PDM/PLM-Systemen oder der Integration von Softwarelösungen in bestehende Unternehmensinfrastrukturen ist wünschenswert
- Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge in robuste, nutzerorientierte Softwarelösungen zu überführen
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Teamfähigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Eigeninitiative sowie eine strukturierte, selbstständige und kooperative Arbeitsweise

title: Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife.

Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis . Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften . Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie .

Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚 Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.

Für unseren Bereich Costing suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine n engagierte n Analytics Engineer , der/die unsere Datenarchitektur im Bereich der direkten Kosten (Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Steuern) auf das nächste Level hebt. In dieser Schlüsselposition bist du das Bindeglied zwischen komplexen regulatorischen Anforderungen, energiewirtschaftlichen Forecasts und unserer Pricing-Strategie. Du liebst es, skalierbare Daten-Pipelines zu bauen, behältst bei wechselnden regulatorischen Vorgaben den Überblick und hast den Anspruch, unsere Systeme durch eine moderne Neuarchitektur zukunftssicher zu machen.

Deine Aufgaben: 
Datenarchitektur & Pipeline Architektur 

- Du verantwortest die Neuarchitektur unserer Datenlandschaft zur Abbildung der direkten Kosten im Energievertrieb.

- Du konzipierst und implementierst robuste ETL/ELT-Pipelines mittels dbt und Airflow , um Daten aus regulatorischen Quellen, Marktdaten und internen Systemen effizient zu verarbeiten.

- Du stellst die Datenqualität und -konsistenz sicher, die als direkte Entscheidungsgrundlage für unser Pricing dient.

Fachliche Konzeption & Monitoring 

- Regulatorisches Monitoring & Implementierung: Du behältst die regulatorischen Entwicklungen im Energiemarkt (wie Änderungen bei Netzentgelten, Steuern und Umlagen) aktiv im Blick und übersetzt diese eigenständig in die notwendigen Anpassungen unserer Datenmodelle und Pipelines.

- Du entwickelst und pflegst Forecast-Modelle für unsere Kostenkomponenten und stellst sicher, dass sich regulatorische Änderungen zeitnah und präzise in den Prognosen widerspiegeln.

- Du übersetzt komplexe energiewirtschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen in performante, logische Datenstrukturen.

Strategische Zusammenarbeit 

- Du agierst als zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Schnittstellen Pricing, Energy Markets (Einkauf/Forecasting) und Gross Margin Controlling.

- Du berätst die Stakeholder bei der methodischen Weiterentwicklung der Kostenberechnung und stellst sicher, dass die analytischen Outputs direkt in die Business-Strategie einfließen.

- Du treibst die technische Weiterentwicklung des Teams voran, indem du Best Practices in der Datenmodellierung etablierst.

Dein Background: 

- Du hast ein Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem ähnlichen quantitativen Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

- Du bringst fundierte Berufserfahrung (Mid-Level bis Senior) als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle mit.

- Du bist ein Profi im Umgang mit SQL und Python. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit dbt und Apache Airflow in produktiven Umgebungen gesammelt.

title: Defense Success Manager, France
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role 

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them): 

- Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing.

- Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout.

What You Will Do 

Own the customer success and value plan

- Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

- Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

- Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

- Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

- Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

- Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

- Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

- Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

- Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

- Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

- Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

- Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

- Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

- Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

- Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

- Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

- Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

- Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

- Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

- Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

- Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security stakeholders, while translating technical trade-offs into clear implications for mission owners and executives. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

- Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints , including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules.

- Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion

- Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.

Nice to have

- Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs.

- Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

- Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

- Familiarity with public procurement, framework agreements and multi-year option structures.

Security & Compliance criteria

- Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

- Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations).

What We Offer 

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page .

Privacy Policy 

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy .

title: Principal + Staff Software Engineers
description:
Unstructured is defining the standard for enterprise data transformation in the age of LLMs and generative AI. In just two years, we've raised over $65M from world-class investors, including Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital, Databricks, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and IBM.

Our open-source toolkit has been downloaded 97M+ times and is used by 90% of the Fortune 1000. We power production AI workflows across commercial and federal sectors — transforming PDFs, HTML, Word docs, images, emails, and more into AI-ready data pipelines that scale.

We're not just building tools; we're building the backbone of generative AI and the infrastructure that unlocks intelligence across industries.

About the Role

Unstructured is looking for Staff and Principal Software Engineers to define the architectural foundation for how enterprises process and transform unstructured data for large-language-model (LLM) applications.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in deep systems work—someone who could write the book on Kubernetes, lives and breathes Python, and understands Postgres at the index and transaction-log level. You’ll own the technical direction for our core platform, guiding how data moves through every layer—from ingestion to transformation to retrieval.

You’ll partner closely with the Head of Engineering, Head of Infrastructure, and product leaders to ensure Unstructured’s systems are performant, resilient, and ready to support the next generation of AI-driven workloads.

Location(s) Preferred: San Francisco, Bay Area, San Jose, Seattle, Sacramento

What You’ll Own & Drive

- 
Define and evolve the end-to-end architecture for Unstructured’s data transformation and retrieval platform.

- 
Build and scale distributed systems that process massive volumes of unstructured data across diverse formats and sources.

- 
Serve as the company-wide authority on Kubernetes orchestration, cluster design, performance tuning, and reliability.

- 
Lead Python architecture and best practices—ensuring performance, modularity, and maintainability across services.

- 
Design and optimize Postgres schemas, queries, and indexing strategies to support large-scale metadata and retrieval pipelines.

- 
Mentor senior engineers through design reviews and code guidance, raising the bar for technical excellence across the org.

- 
Partner with the infrastructure and product teams to translate research prototypes into production-grade systems.

- 
Evaluate emerging technologies and open-source tools in LLM infrastructure, retrieval, and orchestration—deciding where and how to integrate them.

What We're Looking for

- 
Have 10+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on distributed systems, infrastructure, or data architecture.

- 
Are a Python expert—capable of building frameworks and performance-critical services from scratch.

- 
Have deep Kubernetes expertise; you can design, deploy, and debug at scale and could teach others how to productionize it securely.

- 
Are fluent in Postgres—you understand query planning, partitioning, and tuning for high-throughput environments.

- 
Are obsessed with clean, scalable architecture and can lead design reviews that shape how entire systems evolve.

- 
Have experience in high-performance data or AI/ML systems—especially those involving retrieval pipelines, embeddings, or hybrid workloads.

- 
Thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where technical depth and judgment matter more than process.

Bonus Points

- 
Experience building or scaling LLM-powered or RAG systems in production.

- 
Familiarity with open-source orchestration frameworks, vector databases, or hybrid cloud infrastructure.

- 
Contributions to open-source projects in Python, Kubernetes, or distributed systems.

Why You’ll Love It Here 

You’ll be surrounded by smart, kind, low-ego people who genuinely enjoy building together. We invest in our team with company offsites, best-in-tech swag, and the tools you need to do your best work, wherever you’re based.

We support you holistically, not just at work. For full-time, US-based employees, that includes:

- 
Health: Medical, dental, and vision coverage through Justworks, effective the 1st of the month following your start date. All medical plans include fertility coverage, plus access to One Medical, Talkspace (12 free therapy sessions a year), Kindbody, and Teladoc. If you waive medical coverage, we pay a $250/month allowance.

- 
Financial: 401(k) with company match (100% of the first 3% you contribute, 50% of the next 2%), company-paid life insurance, and optional supplemental life, short- and long-term disability, accident, critical illness, and hospital coverage. FSA and HSA options available.

- 
Equity: Stock options, so you share in what we’re building.

- 
Time off: Flexible paid time off (unlimited), up to 80 hours of paid sick leave a year, 12 company holidays, and a company-wide winter break between Christmas and New Year’s.

- 
Family: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents, available after 6 months, plus up to 6 additional unpaid weeks.

- 
Remote setup: A $500 home office stipend and a $75/month cell and internet stipend.

- 
Team: Team and company offsites throughout the year.

We want you focused on building, growing, and staying energized for the long haul. If you’re excited about what we’re building, we’d love to meet you.

Unstructured is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture where everyone can do their best work. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: ALBERT | REMOTE ALMOST ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD| Hiring principal and distinguished engineers to build net new products | up to ~ $750k
description:
ALBERT | REMOTE ALMOST ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD| Hiring principal and distinguished engineers to build net new products | up to ~ $750k
Hiring: exceptional consumer product engineers at Albert. We're a consumer fintech with 25M+ users who trust us to budget, save, invest, and bank in one place. Profitable for 4+ years. And as of today, our average employee tenure is 3.6 years, a number you almost never see in startup tech, and one we're quietly proud of. People stay because the work is good, the people are sharp, and we've built something worth staying for. Now we're building net-new consumer products from zero, and we're looking for people who love to tinker and build stuff to ship them with us. The kind of person we're looking for: • Top fraction of a percentile in craft, the kind of good that's hard to fake • Builds for fun, not just for work. The kind who ships a working prototype over the weekend and can't help themselves • Comfortable owning 0 to 1 consumer products end-to-end • Allergic to politics, theater, and bureaucracy What you get: • Remote, anywhere with reasonable timezone overlap (and for someone truly exceptional, we'll make async work) • Real scale from day one (20M+ users, real money, real consequences) • Compensation that beats the market. We pay well and we mean it. Base, discretionary year-end bonus, meaningful 401(k) match, and meaningful equity in a profitable, growing unicorn (the kind that's actually worth something) • Platinum PPO health benefits with Blue Shield, top of the top of the line, covering your entire family • A mission worth your time: make money simple, so people spend less time managing it and keep more of it • Small senior-heavy teams, direct ownership, no layers • Forthcoming with the business metrics that matter, so you always know how the company is actually doing • The startup perks done right: catered lunches, wellness stipend, team offsites, casual dress. The stuff that compounds when you're showing up engaged for years, not months • Profitable for 4+ years, so you build with conviction, not runway anxiety Stack: python, claude, postgres, react.js /react native If this is you, email us at recruiting@albert.com Edit: we are in the process of rebuilding our career site to speak to how we hire (e.g. hunt, dont post, find the best). Just an FYI Also, we carefully review every application. If we think there may be a fit, we'll reach out within a few business days. Either way, thank you for your interest in what we're building and for taking the time to connect with us.

title: Lead Embedded Software Verification &Validation Engineer - 50% travel required
description:
Shape the future of innovation as we tackle cutting-edge projects that make a difference. We’re not just in the business of engineering—we’re building a brighter future. Driven by creativity and a culture of excellence, we believe in the power of engineering to solve today’s challenges and create opportunities for tomorrow. What we do matters. 

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is looking for a Lead Nuclear Digital Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) IV&V Engineer to provide technical leadership for verifying and validating complex digital control systems used in the nuclear industry.

This is an engineering role—not simply a test execution position. You will determine what needs to be verified, how to test it, and what evidence is needed to demonstrate compliance. You'll work across software, hardware, firmware, FPGA, systems engineering, quality, and project teams to evaluate system performance, identify technical risks, and ensure requirements are fully verified.

Location: Wilmington, NC initially, transitioning to Nampa, ID after approximately six months. Candidates may relocate or travel approximately 50%.

This position supports a project that will be performed in two phases:

- Initial phase: For approximately the first six months, the engineer will support onsite work in Wilmington, NC. Candidates may be based in or temporarily relocate to the Wilmington area or travel onsite approximately 50% of the time, generally in one- to two-week blocks.

- Second phase: After the Wilmington phase, the project will transition to Nampa, ID for the remainder of the assignment. The engineer must be willing to relocate to the Boise–Nampa area or continue traveling onsite approximately 50% of the time.

Citizenship: US Citizen or US Person due to the nature of the work

What You'll Do 

- Lead independent verification and validation (IV&V) activities for nuclear digital I&C and embedded control systems.

- Translate system, hardware, software, firmware, interface, and performance requirements into appropriate verification objectives and test requirements.

- Perform, witness, and evaluate component, subsystem, system, Factory Acceptance, and regression testing.

- Evaluate test results and objective evidence to determine whether requirements have been met.

- Identify anomalies, technical risks, incomplete evidence, and potential compliance issues; drive issues through resolution and closure.

- Document deficiencies and technical issues clearly and support investigation, disposition, corrective action, retest, and closure.

- Perform change-impact assessments and determine appropriate regression testing following design, software, hardware, or configuration changes.

- Support test simulators, automated test equipment, test tools, and production test systems.

- Maintain configuration control of test environments, hardware, software, firmware, test media, and verification evidence.

- Lead or support customer-facing Factory Acceptance Testing, technical reviews, and project execution.

- Communicate test status, technical findings, risks, and recommendations to customers and project leadership.

- Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to engineers and test personnel.

- Work closely with systems, software, hardware, FPGA, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, customers, and project management teams.

Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

- 10+ years of experience in embedded software development, including knowledge of the C programming language and software development tools (GitLab, Jira, LDRA, Arm Development Studio, Visual Studio, GDB, etc.).

- Experience developing and executing verification and validation (V&V) strategies for complex systems.

- Experience developing test plans, test procedures, test reports, and requirements traceability.

- Strong understanding of configuration management and requirements-based testing.

- Strong judgment in verification strategy and objective evidence

- Experience with software development in a safety-critical environment (DO-178, ISO 26262).

- Willingness and ability to travel extensively and support extended onsite assignments.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Familiarity with nuclear industry processes and standards.

- Intermediate knowledge of standard programming languages (e.g., Python).

- Experience adopting and/or integrating emerging technologies (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, digital assistants) into day-to-day operations for continuous improvement.

The QDSS Advantage 

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future. 

What You’ll Find Here 

- Work That Matters – Next-generation, safety- and mission-critical projects where your contributions have real-world impact. 

- Growth That’s Supported – Competitive compensation, employer-matched 401(k), certification assistance, and clear opportunities for advancement. 

- A Culture That Works – A flexible, collaborative, and people-first environment where teamwork, innovation, and balance are valued. 

Benefits Include 

- Competitive pay, comprehensive medical/dental/life and disability coverage, 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, friendly workplace. 

Full compensation package is based on candidate experience and certifications

Pay Ranges

$130,000—$150,000 USD

At Quest Defense Systems and Solutions , we don’t just build technology — we engineer the future. From next-generation aerospace solutions to cutting-edge defense systems, we tackle the toughest, mission-critical challenges that keep people safe and push the boundaries of innovation. This is where problem-solvers, innovators, and visionary thinkers come together to shape the future. With over 25 years of aerospace and defense engineering expertise, our commitment to delivering high-quality, transformative solutions sets us apart — not just as an industry leader, but as a driving force for impactful change. Together, we’re not just leading the industry — we’re revolutionizing it.

title: Cloud Engineer Automation
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth . We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team: 

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role: 

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) AI Engineer ! 

Missions

🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots

En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :

- ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids

- c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle

Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. 

C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :

- une plateforme collaborative et ouverte , qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises

- l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc.

- la valorisation des données de paie et sociales , pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…

L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH.

🚀 Tes responsabilités

Ta mission : faire de l'IA le levier qui démultiplie le travail de chacun chez Alassio. L'objectif est assumé : multiplier par 10 la productivité de chaque membre de l'équipe.

- Tu formes la Growth squad avec notre Founding Strategy & Operations : ce binôme transverse optimise l'existant, automatise les workflows de toutes les équipes et fait passer nos initiatives IA et nos outils internes à l'échelle : hébergement et mise en production dans des environnements partagés, sécurité, observabilité, optimisation et amélioration continue

- Tu deviens le (la) référent(e) IA d'Alassio : on se veut profondément AI-native et on expérimente énormément. Tu centralises et coordonnes ces initiatives pour que ce "lab interne" soit efficace, et tu expérimentes aussi en continu avec toutes les techno IA (budget et outillage conséquents)

- Tu construis la nouvelle colonne vertébrale IT d'Alassio , en identifiant les systèmes IA qui comptent à l'échelle de toute l'entreprise

- Tu prépares l'avenir du produit : à terme, les usages testés et éprouvés en interne sous ton impulsion ont vocation à rejoindre notre plateforme. Ils nourriront le « People OS » qui démocratise les cas d'usage les plus pertinents de l'IA dans notre secteur

🧭 Tes premiers chantiers

Ton point de départ : Bedrock, notre OS interne. Un peu à la manière de Palantir Foundry, il agrège & orchestre tout le contexte de l'entreprise pour en tirer des actions concrètes : suivi ultra-personnalisé et automatisé de nos utilisateurs, analyse produit, documentation, rédaction de tickets et PR associées…

Bedrock est déjà au cœur du quotidien de toutes les équipes. Mais il s'est construit par couches successives, au fil des cas d'usage ajoutés. Ton premier objectif est d'en dresser l'inventaire complet, process et outils IA compris. Tu définis ensuite la roadmap qui le fera changer de dimension :

- Workflows : optimiser l'existant

- Infrastructure : sécurité, confidentialité, hébergement et environnements partagés, pour un OS multi-joueur, plug-and-play et scalable

title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
description:
De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen.

Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector.

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.

Dit ga je doen:

- Samenwerken met toezichthouders om risico’s voor consumenten tijdig te signaleren.

- Ontwikkelen van dataproducten die inzichten vertalen naar gerichte acties.

- Implementeren van betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen voor effectiever toezicht.

- Visualiseren van resultaten in dashboards die toezichthouders ondersteunen.

- Kansen signaleren om processen slimmer in te richten en repetitief werk te automatiseren.

- Experimenteren met nieuwe technieken zoals AI om toezicht slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

Team 
Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR.

Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. Ook kijkt het team naar risico’s van nieuwe technologie in de financiële sector. Zo spelen we een belangrijke rol in het tijdig herkennen van risico’s.

De deadline voor deze vacature is 25 november 2026. 

Dit vragen we: 

⭐ Een afgeronde WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Business Analytics, Wiskunde, Econometrie, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare (bèta) studie met een sterke analytische of statistische component.

⭐ Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring en kennis van het data/science werkveld en de daarbij behorende tools en technieken. Hierbij is ervaring met Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Python, Azure Data Bricks een vereiste.

⭐Kennis van softwareontwikkeling, versiebeheer, codereview en unit testing is vereist.

⭐ Analytisch sterk: het vermogen om complexe datasets te analyseren, patronen te herkennen en inzichten te genereren. Je neemt informatie niet zonder meer aan, toetst aannames en identificeert risico’s, afwijkingen en mogelijke blinde vlekken.

⭐ Proactieve houding: je werkt graag samen en draagt bij aan het gezamenlijke succes, tegelijkertijd kan je zelfstandig knopen doorhakken en analyses omzetten in concrete en bruikbare uitkomsten.

⭐ Communicatieve vaardigheden: je kunt complexe technische informatie helder en beknopt overbrengen aan niet of minder-technische collega’s. Ervaring met datavisualisatie om gegevens begrijpelijk en toegankelijk te presenteren voor verschillende belanghebbenden.

Please note: excellent proficiency in Dutch, both verbal and written, is required for this position. 

Wat wij bieden: 

📄 Je start met een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

💰 Afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring word je ingeschaald in schaal F (junior, met een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €52.500 en €87.000) of schaal G (medior, met een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €62.000 en €103.500). Bedragen zijn op basis van een 36-urige werkweek, inclusief 13e maand en vakantiegeld

⏰ 36-urige werkweek, werkdagen in overleg (bijv. 4x9)

🌴 199,5 vakantie-uren per jaar (bovenop je standaard roostervrije dag)

💻 Een laptop en een smartphone

📚 Uitgebreide trainings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden

🚆 Volledige vergoeding van OV-reiskosten (2e klas)

🏡 Thuiswerkvergoeding voor thuiswerkdagen

💪 Bijdrage aan een sportschoolabonnement

🚲 Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een fiets- en deviceregeling en vergoeding voor je thuiswerkplek

description:

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

We’re looking for a AI Quantitative Research Intern to join our researchers and traders in Amsterdam. You'll join our option pricing team and work alongside experienced Quantitative Researchers, Traders and Analysts, with a dedicated mentor guiding your project.

What will you do? 

You’ll have the opportunity to help shape an emerging field, taking ownership of designing and improving our agent-driven research framework. You’ll have the freedom to explore new approaches, pioneer solutions, and make a meaningful impact on how we conduct research.

You will:

- Architect our agent-driven research framework, designing networks of agents and harnesses.

- Design research pipelines and experimentation loops with quants and traders.

- Build evaluation and feedback mechanisms that show what’s working and what isn’t.

- Own the framework in use: track how it performs and keep improving it.

- Share what you learn, so the team keeps improving its AI setup.

What we’re looking for 

You’ll need:

- To have a background in a highly quantitative field, with a focus on AI (MSc or PhD)

- At least 6 months of practical experience with LLMs, agents, and harnesses.

- Comfort designing evaluation and feedback loops that tell you whether an agent is actually improving.

- High ownership and clear communication.

- Availability to start in (early) 2027, full-time and on-site in Amsterdam, for a minimum of 12 weeks.

Nice to have

- Experience using AI for quantitative research, such as working on math problems.

- Python, and exposure to trading.

Dates, location, and accommodation 

- Duration: From 12 to 16 weeks, with flexible duration and start date.

- Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office.

- After the internship: the opportunity to convert into a full-time role after graduation, based on performance.

What else is in it for you 

- A dedicated mentor and a great team of colleagues to learn from.

- An in-house training program and a close look at how engineering, research, and trading work together.

- An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems.

- Sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer.

- Weekly Friday drinks and other celebrations.

- Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and soft drinks all day.

How we work 

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

You'll be challenged from day one, with a mentor and diverse team around you. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Excited to join us? 

Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days.

Our culture 

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.
