title: Graduate Risk Analyst
description:
Your IMC journey begins with a three-week Global Trainee Program led by our seasoned engineers and traders, during which you’ll link up with graduates from all IMC regions: Europe, the United States, India and Asia-Pacific. During this traineeship, you’ll learn more about IMC, the basics of trading and options theory. Training continues back at your local office, where you’ll receive support from a dedicated mentor. As a Graduate Risk Analyst, you operate at the beating heart of our business: in the dealing room of IMC’s Amsterdam office. Your work supports IMC’s critical day-to-day risk management activities, including the monitoring and analysis of our markets, as well as our credit, liquidity, and operational risks. What happens next is up to you!

YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILTIES 

- Become an expert in options, financial markets, and how IMC applies algorithmic trading as a market maker

- Contribute to the ongoing development of IMC’s proprietary risk management systems, together with our Engineers

- Analyse developments in the markets in which we trade and identify risks and opportunities

- Be an integral part of your team by advising on limit requests, monitoring intraday and overnight risks, and discussing key exposures with our trading desks

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES 

- Recent or upcoming graduates seeking to join IMC full-time in February 2027

- An academic background in Mathematics, Physics and/or Econometrics or a related field

- Proficiency in a programming language is preferred (Python, MATLAB or R)

- First-class analytical skills and a desire to solve complicated problems creatively

- A genuine interest in financial markets

Please note: If you have already applied for this position during the current recruitment season and were not selected, you may reapply when the next recruitment season begins in Summer 2027. We encourage you to focus on enhancing your skillset before reapplying.

Due to current U.S. immigration and visa restrictions, some candidates may not be eligible to obtain the U.S. business visa required as part of our Global Traineeship Programme. As the programme includes mandatory training in the United States shortly after joining, we are unfortunately unable to proceed with applications from candidates who are unable to obtain the required visa within the programme timeline.

If you are a dual passport holder of another nationality or a European citizen who wants to relocate back to Europe, you remain welcome to apply and should inform our campus recruitment team of your situation: About Us 

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

title: Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais)
description:
Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais) 

Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Niveau : Senior Product Manager
Équipe : Device Data Management (DDM)
Contrat : CDI

À noter : ce poste est basé en France. Vous devez donc y résider ou être prêt·e à déménager, et disposer déjà du droit de travailler dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous l’examinons poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. 

Un français et un anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous demandons de soumettre votre CV en anglais . À propos de Kaluza 

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel à travers les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez : 

Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran.

- Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données.

- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France.

- Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

- Aligner les équipes globales et locales, toutes fonctions confondues : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, la QA et bien d’autres, avec une influence full-stack, pour que tout le monde vise les bons résultats.

- Être la personne de référence pour DDM France : faire le lien entre nos équipes globales et locales afin d’éclairer les priorités et la stratégie.

Ce que vous apportez : 

Critères essentiels :

- Une expérience avérée en tant que Product Manager, Business Analyst ou équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un solide historique de localisation réussie de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux

- Un français courant et une grande aisance en anglais : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, vous passez donc facilement de l’un à l’autre

- De l’aisance dans le travail direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les décideurs alignés et impliqués

- Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard·e et opérationnel·le, vous préférez construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt qu’attendre la spécification parfaite. title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
description:
About Us 

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do? 

- Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

- Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

- Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

- Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

- Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

- Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

- Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

- Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications 

Core Requirements: 

- BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

- 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

- Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

- Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

- Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

- A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

- Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points 

- Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

- Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

- Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

- Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer: 

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare 

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. 

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Data Scientist – Statistisch Onderzoek
description:
Je bent recent afgestudeerd van een bèta / kwantitatieve opleiding, bent statistisch goed onderlegd en je hebt ook al enige ervaring opgedaan met R, SPSS en/of Python en op zoek naar een mogelijkheid om je eerste stappen in de wereld van Data te zetten. Wij hebben dan een erg gave uitdaging in de aanbieding waarin je je kunt ontwikkelen binnen een publieke omgeving waarin je met onderzoek data het verschil kunt maken binnen maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Als Data Scientist – Statistisch Onderzoek werk je binnen een team wat zich richt op beleidsonderzoek en informatie binnen de verschillende domeinen van een lokale overheidsinstelling. Dit team verzamelt statistische informatie over het stedelijk gebied en voert uiteenlopende onderzoeken uit: van snelle opiniepeilingen tot diepgaande data-analyses en dashboards. Jij speelt hierbij een centrale rol: je beheert databanken, ontwikkelt dashboards, ondersteunt grootschalige enquêtes, en zorgt dat data toegankelijk én begrijpelijk wordt gemaakt voor collega’s en beleidsmakers. Je werkt met tools als R, SPSS, Python en Tableau, en krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise in data, visualisatie en statistiek volop te ontwikkelen.

Wat kun je verwachten? 

Met deze opdracht binnen het Data & Analytics traineeship geef jij jouw carrière een vliegende start! In twee jaar tijd behaal je waardevolle certificaten, volg je boeiende trainingen op ons gezellige kantoor in Bunnik, én werk je aan uitdagende projecten bij één van onze opdrachtgevers.

Tijdens het eerste jaar ligt de focus op jouw ontwikkeling als professional én als persoon. In de eerste twee weken duik je met andere trainees ons kantoor in, waar je trainingen volgt in zowel soft als hard skills. Daarna ga je aan de slag bij je opdrachtgever. In het tweede jaar werk je samen met ons aan een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan dat helemaal is afgestemd op jouw ambities.

Wat bieden wij jou? 

- Een vliegende start als Data Scientist – Statistisch Onderzoek via een tweejarig traineeship boordevol trainingen, masterclasses, certificaten en praktijkervaring

- Persoonlijke één-op-één begeleiding en een leertraject dat meegroeit met jouw ambities

- Een startsalaris tussen de €2.600 - €2.800, passend bij jouw achtergrond en ervaring

- Betaalde opleidingen, vakinhoudelijke cursussen en volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling

- 25 vakantiedagen, vakantiegeld én reiskostenvergoeding op maat

- Gezelligheid gegarandeerd: borrels, teamuitjes en events om je netwerk uit te breiden

Dit vragen wij van jou: 

- Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding, van waaruit je aantoonbaar ervaring hebt met het maken van statistische analyses en modellen.

- Je kunt goed schakelen tussen data en praktijk: je vertaalt cijfers naar bruikbare inzichten.

- Je bent nieuwsgierig, oplossingsgericht en professioneel in je communicatie

- Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed en staat stevig in je schoenen

title: Quality Assurance - Consultant
location: Hybrid - Newcastle, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Manchester, Birmingham, Bristol, London
description:
Ready to keep quality at the heart of projects with impact? 

Do you want to make a real impact by building quality into services from the very start? Are you an experienced Test engineer who can quickly understand a client environment, build strong relationships and help teams deliver with confidence?

We’re a growing tech consultancy creating user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in the public sector. As a Quality Assurance Consultant, you’ll bring strong testing expertise and a consultancy mindset, joining multidisciplinary client teams and making an impact from day one. You’ll champion our automation-first, shift-left approach to quality, building automated testing into delivery from the outset and embedding quality throughout the lifecycle. You’ll identify risks early, provide rapid feedback, prevent defects and continuously improve quality. You’ll be confident questioning assumptions, influencing technical and quality decisions, and adapting quickly to different technologies, teams and client environments.

The role 

You'll work on public and private sector projects. You may be the sole software quality engineer on a project or work in a team.

Leading by example and promoting the Opencast approach, you'll work in an agile environment across all testing types. You'll collaborate with team members, clients and users to maintain quality and follow best practice. You'll adapt to different tools and technologies, advising on the best and mentoring junior colleagues.

You'll ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client. 

Requirements 

We’re looking for people with experience delivering digital services within the public sector, with an understanding of GDS standards and ways of working. 

You’ll need strong test automation experience, including hands-on involvement in building, developing or maintaining automation frameworks. You should be comfortable contributing to automation strategy and embedding effective testing practices throughout the delivery lifecycle.

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients. 

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements. 
If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying. 

We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply. 

Technical Skills 

To succeed in this role, you must have experience working as the sole software test engineer on a team and be confident taking ownership of test automation.

In your CV and at interview, you’ll need to show experience of:

- Building, developing and maintaining test automation frameworks, not just writing or executing automated tests within an existing framework.

- Developing and running front-end and API test automation, using tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber BDD or JUnit.

- Writing, maintaining and debugging automated tests across applications and services, using technologies such as Java, Kotlin, Scala, TypeScript or JavaScript.

- Driving automation within a multidisciplinary team, identifying what should be automated and helping to embed automation throughout the development lifecycle.

- Presenting work to stakeholders.

- Managing defects and tasks through to resolution.

- Creating user stories and technical tasks from high-level requirements.

- Using version control tools such as Git and working with peer review processes.

- Creating test plans and reports.

- Participating in end-to-end (E2E) testing and user acceptance testing (UAT). 

You'll need a good understanding of: 

- Your working area and applying this to your role

- Concepts and benefits of non-functional testing

- Continuous integration tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI or CircleCI

- Basic principles of programming paradigms, such as object-orientated and procedural programming

Essential Skills 

As well as QA skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be a great consultant.

In the interview, we will assess how you have:

- Organised your workload to ensure you're completing tasks efficiently to ensure quality is unaffected

- Strong attention to detail

- A methodical approach to resolving complex problems

- Respectfully challenged decisions or solutions

- Bring recent government (public sector) experience .

- Deliver complex digital services aligned to Government Digital Service (GDS) standards.

- Communicated with technical and non-technical people

- Been proactive and taken the initiative in seeking solutions to mitigate risk

- Raised risks and issues through the correct tools

Other experience 

Some areas of experience are not essential but relevant to the role:

- 
Agile methodology

Salary 

£48,000 - £54,000 

What we offer 

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from flexible working hours (aligned to client commitments), 25 days’ holiday, and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations. title: Product Engineer, Full Stack
description:
Headquarters: Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States

URL: https://comeandsee.bamboohr.com/careers 

JOIN THE COME AND SEE TEAM 

Product Engineer, Full Stack 

Great stories only matter when they reach people, and you build the way they get there. If you love shipping software that holds up in production and see engineering as a way to serve people well – we’d love to meet you.

ABOUT US 

Come and See is the faith-based nonprofit media ministry behind The Chosen . Our mission is inviting everyone to encounter Jesus through exceptional storytelling that brings the Bible to life. Our Team Members work together as collaborators in the greatest mission on earth.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

The Product Engineer, Full Stack will build and ship features across our streaming apps on web, mobile, and connected TV, the platform services behind them, and the tools our partners rely on, working with Product and Design from user problem to production. This is a full-time, remote role open to candidates in the USA.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

- Start and end with the user. Partner with Product, Design, and stakeholders to understand user problems before building, and watch how features perform after launch so you can improve them.

- Shape what gets built. Contribute to discovery, refinement, and technical planning, and break features into small deliveries that put value in front of users early.

- Build across the stack. Design, build, and maintain features across web, mobile, connected TV, and backend services, building depth in new areas along the way.

- Write code others can change. Deliver clear, well-tested, maintainable code to our standards, and give and receive code review feedback that raises the whole team’s work.

- Own delivery and release. Run CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, deployment, and release readiness so changes ship with confidence.

- Make problems visible early. Build observability into what ships, and join incident response and root-cause analysis through to the fix.

- Pay down technical debt. Address debt that affects product quality, reliability, or delivery speed.

- Own your AI-assisted work. Use AI tools across coding, testing, debugging, and documentation, validate the output as rigorously as hand-written code, and share with the team where AI helps and where it doesn’t.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 

- 3–5 years building and shipping production software

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or 4+ years of equivalent professional experience

- Strong TypeScript experience across client applications, backend services, and the pipelines that ship them

- Depth in frontend, mobile, or backend development, with willingness to work across the full range

- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containerized deployments, and CI/CD tooling

- Comfort across the full product and software life cycle, and ownership of work after it ships

- A personal faith in Jesus and alignment with our mission, values, and Statement of Faith

BONUS POINTS: Mobile development (Kotlin or Swift), connected TV platform experience, nonprofit or ministry/faith-based organizational experience

BENEFITS: Medical, dental, vision, retirement match, HRA, disability and life insurance, generous and flexible time off, holidays, parental leave, and more.

OUR BELIEFS, CULTURE, AND COMMITMENT 

At Come and See, every staff member is a critical and valuable part of our mission and ministry. We consider ministry readiness and an individual’s capacity to represent our culture and Christian beliefs during the selection process for all staff positions. An essential function within every position held by a staff member at Come and See is to uphold and represent Jesus in how we live and behave.

While we unite around our mission, we know unity doesn’t mean uniformity. Our calling is too great, and our mission is too important not to be intentional about strengthening our team with people from all backgrounds. We believe that varied perspectives—across race, ethnicity, life experience, age, and gender—enrich our ability to share the story of Jesus with the world and help everyone, everywhere, experience the authentic Jesus.

Come and See is an equal opportunity employer and as a religious organization, lawfully exercises its right under Title VII and applicable state law to employ individuals who share its religious beliefs.

For accommodations, contact peopleandculture@comeandseefoundation.org

title: Staff Software Engineer, Ecosystem
description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://joinblvd.com 

Who is Boulevard? 

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . 

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most .

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. 

Boulevard customers are passionate about what they do. Their needs are nuanced and critical, and they rely on us to stand alongside them so they can focus on what they do best. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Ecosystem team, you’ll set the technical direction for Boulevard’s external developer platform and its app and integrations ecosystem, then work across teams to make it real.

This is a green field opportunity. You’ll shape the API platform, the partner experience, and the foundations partners and customers depend on, including API security, identity and access, audit trails, and eventing infrastructure. It’s an individual contributor role with wide influence: you won’t manage people, you’ll lead through technical judgment, clear communication, and trust, working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Design, Partnerships, and Product Marketing. We’re small enough that your work is visible every day.

What you’ll do here: 

- Set the technical strategy for Boulevard’s API and app ecosystem, making sure it supports company goals and partner needs.

- Work across engineering teams to align on direction and drive the right implementation, without formal authority over those teams.

- Lead platform-level changes that cross team boundaries: gain agreement, plan the rollout, and see the work through.

- Find the gaps between what the platform provides and what business priorities require, and turn them into clear, scoped, prioritized proposals.

- Learn what partners and integrators need and bring those needs into the platform roadmap.

- Write and review design documents and architecture decisions, explaining trade-offs and risks to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Write code and ship high-impact work, setting the standard for quality, observability, and security.

- Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and coaching, and remove blockers so teammates can do their best work.

- Define and monitor system health metrics for the API platform, address technical debt before it affects reliability or performance, and help guide incidents from response to resolution and improvement.

What you’ll need to thrive: 

- Experience as a Staff-level or senior engineer who has led large, cross-team technical initiatives.

- Experience building and scaling external-facing API products. GraphQL experience is strongly preferred.

- Experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs.

- Experience designing and operating systems at scale, including enterprise-grade systems.

- Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, Go, or Elixir. Elixir experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

- Influence without authority and sound technical judgment: you gain alignment through clear reasoning and trust, and you anticipate scale, maintenance, and operational cost.

- Business and partner awareness, and clear communication: you connect technical decisions to business priorities and partner needs, and adapt your message to your audience.

- A mentor’s mindset, ownership, and forward thinking: you help other engineers grow, move work forward when the path is unclear, state risks openly, and set long-term direction while delivering value in the short term.

- A plus: experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

How we’ll take care of you: 

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $193,900 - 225,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

- Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.

- Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.

- Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.

- An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.

- 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.

- 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.

- Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free. 

- Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success. 

- $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.

- And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice .

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. 

Outside Employment Disclosure 
Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Because of that, we ask all candidates to disclose any concurrent employment, self-employment, ownership interest, or advisory role during the hiring process, including the company name and industry. Disclosure is a normal part of our process and is not by itself a barrier to being hired. Employees in Tier 1 Restricted Roles may not hold concurrent employment, ownership, or an advisory role with a beauty, wellness, self-care, or med-spa business, or with a company that competes with Boulevard. If you currently hold such a role, you are still welcome to apply — please raise it early with your recruiter so we can talk it through. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/boulevard-staff-software-engineer-ecosystem

https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. QA Automation Engineer 

Every person who presses play deserves a product that works, and quality is how we honor them. If you love building systems that catch problems early and see quality as a way to serve people well – we’d love to meet you.

ABOUT US 

Come and See is the faith-based nonprofit media ministry behind The Chosen . Our mission is inviting everyone to encounter Jesus through exceptional storytelling that brings the Bible to life. Our Team Members work together as collaborators in the greatest mission on earth.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

The QA Automation Engineer will build our automated testing strategy and coverage across web, mobile, connected TV, API, and backend platforms, integrate testing into our CI/CD pipelines, and support manual and exploratory testing where automation isn’t yet practical. - Shape the testing strategy. Help define automation standards, choose the right testing layers for each product, and prioritize by risk, business impact, and effort.

- Champion testability. Advocate for quality throughout the development lifecycle and mentor teammates on where automation adds value and where manual validation still belongs.

- Build automated test suites. Design, write, and maintain tests for critical user journeys, APIs, and integrations, with reusable frameworks, fixtures, and patterns for test data and mocking.

- Keep tests reliable. Diagnose and fix flaky tests, and keep suites maintainable as products and architecture evolve.

- Choose the right tools. Evaluate, prototype, and recommend testing frameworks and services, including AI approaches to test creation and maintenance, before wider adoption.

- Wire testing into CI/CD. Work with Engineering on which tests run for pull requests, builds, deployments, and scheduled regression, and help set quality gates that don’t slow delivery.

- Make quality visible. Improve visibility into test results, failures, and trends, and trace failures to application code, test code, infrastructure, or environments.

- Test what automation can’t. Perform manual, exploratory, and regression testing across supported platforms and devices, and document and help diagnose defects.

- Improve with the team. Work with Product Managers, Engineers, and Product Operations to validate acceptance criteria, learn from recurring defects, and keep improving our practices.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 

- 5+ years in software quality assurance, test automation, or software engineering, using modern automated testing frameworks

- Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests

- Experience testing web applications, APIs, mobile applications, or other digital platforms

- Strong grasp of testing principles, including regression, integration, end-to-end, exploratory, and risk-based testing

- Experience diagnosing failures across applications, tests, environments, and integrations

- A personal faith in Jesus and alignment with our mission, values, and Statement of Faith

BONUS POINTS: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, experience establishing or expanding an automated testing program, testing across web, iOS, Android, and connected TV, CI/CD integration, API and integration testing, cloud testing infrastructure or device farms, performance or accessibility testing, e xperience leveraging AI-assisted development or testing tools to improve engineering productivity and test automation , streaming, media, or high-scale consumer product experience, nonprofit or ministry/faith-based organizational experience

BENEFITS: Medical, dental, vision, retirement match, HRA, disability and life insurance, generous and flexible time off, holidays, parental leave, and more.

OUR BELIEFS, CULTURE, AND COMMITMENT

CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role: 

The Regional Principal Analyst is the most senior technical individual contributor within a Falcon Complete region, serving as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and their immediate leadership teams. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across multiple fireteams, supporting on complex incident response, conducting deep technical case review, identifying operations and product improvement opportunities, and driving technical quality across regional operations through various technical deliverables. The Regional Principal Analyst maintains deep, current expertise through regular hands-on engagement, and collaboration in complex service delivery scenarios.

What You'll Do: 

Technical Leadership: 

- Serve as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership Team on all Falcon Complete service delivery matters 
- Ensure technical consistency, quality standards, and best practices across regional operations 
- Lead regional technical initiatives 
- Coordinate with other Regional Principals to ensure global consistency and knowledge sharing

Technical Escalation Support: 

- Serve as a technical escalation resource for Fireteam Principal Analysts on complex or ambiguous cases, providing second opinion, additional analysis, and technical guidance, while assisting with Principal technical development 
- Fireteam Principal Analysts retain ownership and lead of high-severity incident response; the Regional Principal supports as a technical resource, and highlights opportunities to improve the Falcon Complete service and technical excellence of the region. 
- Perform independent technical analysis when asked to validate or extend a fireteam's findings 

Operational Excellence & Quality Assurance: 

- Conduct technical QA reviews of closed cases across fireteams against defined criteria with documented findings 
- Identify detection gaps, false-positive patterns, and coverage opportunities from regional case data; route findings to relevant teams as improvement requests 
- Identify opportunities for tooling, telemetry, or workflow improvements based on recurring case patterns 
- Identify regional trends in detection patterns, threat landscape, and case quality 
- Identify skill gaps and development opportunities across the regional analyst population 
- Drive adoption of consistent operational standards and agentic toolsets across regional operations. 

Cross-Functional Technical Liaison 

- Represent regional technical perspective in cross-functional initiatives with other CrowdStrike business units 
- Work directly with Product/Engineering to surface detection coverage gaps, platform bugs, and feature requests 
- Coordinate with OverWatch and Intelligence on regional threat trends 
- Partner with other Regional Principal Analysts on shared technical review standards and case QA criteria 
- Partner with Watchtower to drive detection tuning and coverage improvements based on regional intelligence. 

Thought Leadership & Market Engagement 

- Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, conference presentations, and other speaking events as appropriate

Strategic Projects & Innovation 

- Provide Technical expertise on regional projects that align with Falcon Complete mission and corporate goals 
- Drive innovation in detection gaps, triage, remediation, and automation capabilities 
- Collaborate with Section 3 (S3) AI Automation Team on regional automation opportunities 
- Identify and implement efficiency improvements with measurable regional impact 

Supervision & Autonomy 

- Works under minimal direction with high degree of autonomy 
- Works independently on technical matters 
- Expected to remain hands-on 
- Determines and pursues courses of action essential to achieving regional and corporate objectives 
- Provides consultative guidance to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership 

What You'll Need 

Successful candidates will have extensive experience in multiple of the following areas: 

- Incident Handling: expert-level experience leading and managing complex incident response investigations, including the ability to take ownership of high-severity, multi-host, and multi-customer incidents from triage through remediation. Proven experience investigating host/user compromises, organized crime groups, and sophisticated nation-state adversaries. 
- Threat Landscape Awareness: deep expertise in attack vectors, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with advanced proficiency applying and extending MITRE ATT&CK to drive detection improvements and investigation strategies. 
- Computer Forensic Analysis: advanced experience conducting forensic analysis across host, memory, and network artifacts using a broad toolkit to determine full scope and root cause of compromise.

- Lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to architecture decisions.
- Track industry trends and improve system performance, resilience, and developer productivity.

Required

- Hands on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI and Jenkins.

- Self motivated. You work well on your own in a fast paced, agile environment.
- Fast learner who adapts to new technologies, teams, and environments.

description:
Headquarters: 

URL: http://www.kiavi.com 

THE TEAM 

Our Property Analytics team is made up of 360-degree thinkers that analyze complex problems and come up with creative solutions. We love to combine advanced analytics and machine learning skills with deep domain knowledge about the business when creating solutions. You will work with some of the most fascinating data sets in the world, alongside a world-class group of product engineers, sales and marketing leaders, and business operators.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE 

Figure’s Property Analytics team is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to join us in our effort to reinvent real estate lending. You will be working alongside engineering, product, and business leaders to tackle complex research and machine learning problems related to automated valuation models (AVMs), asset valuation, and process optimization.

An ideal candidate brings deep expertise in advanced machine learning, statistical modeling, and production-grade AI system architectures. You will lead technical direction, mentor team members, and partner closely with MLOps engineers, Product Managers, Credit Risk Management and Capital Markets subject matter experts to drive select strategic initiatives from initial research to production deployment. If you are keen on joining a dynamic company and solving intellectually challenging problems in a fast-paced environment, please reach out to us.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Lead the end-to-end design, architecture, development, and deployment of state-of-the-art automated valuation modeling (AVM) systems for novel lending products.

- Architect and refine innovative machine learning, deep learning, and statistical models for asset valuation, incorporating spatial-temporal trends, macroeconomic factors, market liquidity, and property risk dynamics.

- Establish robust quantitative frameworks for continuous model performance assessment, monitoring, and automated retraining across changing real estate cycles.

- Build analytical tools and frameworks to empower cross-functional teams across risk, underwriting, and capital markets.

- Partner closely with data infrastructure and MLOps engineering teams to drive initiatives that enhance data capabilities, build feature stores, and streamline real-time inference infrastructure.

- Design useful data attributes and feature representations, leveraging structured, unstructured, and multimodal data sources (e.g., property photos, listing descriptions, spatial features).

- Perform exploratory data analysis, evaluate frontier AI capabilities, and make strategic recommendations to improve current decisioning frameworks and valuation accuracy.

- Refactor and optimize existing analytical solutions and algorithmic components to improve scalability, reliability, and execution efficiency.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS: 

- Ph.D. or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning) with 5+ years of industry experience (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.) building and deploying machine learning models in production.

- Proven track record of developing statistical and machine learning models at an account, customer, or real estate asset level.

- Solid understanding and hands-on application of advanced machine learning techniques, deep learning, spatial analytics, and AI capabilities.

- Strong production-level programming skills in Python, SQL, and R.

- Demonstrated experience in technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring junior team members.

- Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical, algorithmic, and mathematical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS: 

- Hands-on experience developing, evaluating, and deploying Automated Valuation Models (AVMs) or automated appraisal systems.

- Exposure to time-to-event/survival analysis, financial econometric modeling, or spatial-temporal forecasting.

- Experience handling and modeling unstructured data, including computer vision or natural language processing applications in real estate.

- Proficiency with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark) and modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).

- Experience with Monte Carlo simulations, Bayesian inference, or causal machine learning.

- Familiarity with MLOps best practices, cloud architecture (AWS/GCP), feature stores, and model serving infrastructure.

- Progress towards or completion of relevant quantitative/financial certifications (e.g., FRM or CFA).

title: Senior Data Engineers
description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/sx6tzFKwyUTPcquYzQkRFu/jobs-at-movement-labs 

Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term.

As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment.

We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. 

What the work looks like for our data team: 

- Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement
- Serve as technical partner to program teams
- Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies
- Load-test our systems to prepare for elections 
- Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching
- Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness
- Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting
Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar.

This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date.

Responsibilities - Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar
- Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts
- Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones
- Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review
- Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers
- Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles

- Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power
- 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations
- Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
- Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow
- A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end
- Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them
- Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers
- Genuine commitment to the mission of stopping fascism and building progressive power, and comfort operating on a political calendar

Nice to Have:

- Experience in the progressive, political, advocacy, or nonprofit sector — including awareness of c3/c4/PAC boundaries and the sensitivities of political and voter data
- Familiarity with election results, voter file data, and the tools campaigns use to organize, text, and contact voters
- Experience on Google Cloud Platform 
- Experience in on-call rotations and mentoring less-experienced engineers
We’re looking for candidates with a wide range of skills and experience. If you’re excited about the job, even if you don’t match all the characteristics, we encourage you to apply. 

- Base salary of $90,000-$150,000
- Excellent health, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, and unlimited Paid Time Off 
- Remote first culture with teammates all around the country.
- This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. We love to keep top performers if possible.

Applications may be reviewed earlier on a rolling basis so it benefits candidates to apply as soon as possible. The application process includes a phone screen, an exercise, and a full interview with the hiring manager. Due to the nature of our work, the process is moving quickly, and we hope candidates will start as soon as possible. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States. We are not able to provide sponsorship at this time.

Movement Labs is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. If you require accommodations as part of the hiring process, please contact careers@movementlabs.com.

Applications are reviewed by our hiring team—not automated systems. Our hiring process may include AI-assisted analysis of candidate materials, however, hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer

Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits 

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

- Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

- Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

- Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

- Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

- Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

- 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

- You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

- You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

- You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

- You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

- You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

title: Databricks QA Engineer
description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/kb5Wja5n4RGDc2pq5FujAz/jobs-at-v4c.ai 

About V4C V4C is a pure-play Databricks partner, and in under two years we have earned 850+ Databricks certifications across 325+ customers and been named Databricks' 2026 Partner of the Year (C&SI Emerging).

As a Databricks QA Engineer on our data engineering team you will own the quality gate for enterprise data platforms, working directly with customers. You will work on live enterprise data platforms alongside one of the most heavily Databricks-certified delivery teams in the market.

The Role This is a QA role for people who understand data engineering, not general software QA pointed at a data project. You will validate Lakehouse pipelines, which means reasoning about row counts, schema drift, late-arriving data, and silent transformation errors no UI will ever surface. Our approach is automation-first: suites in Python and PySpark, running in CI, blocking promotion when they fail. You own release sign-off, which makes you the last person between a customer and bad data in production. 

Responsibilities

- Own test strategy and release sign-off on engagements, including documented test plans covering scope, risk, and coverage
- Build and maintain automated test suites in Python and PySpark (pytest), integrated into CI pipelines
- Validate data pipelines end to end: ingestion, Medallion layer transformations, Delta Lake tables, and ELT workflows
- Implement data quality rules as code, including Lakeflow expectations and reusable validation frameworks
- Run regression validation after code changes and maintain CI quality gates that block merge or promotion on failure
- Partner with engineers to identify automation candidates and raise the coverage bar across the practice

- 5+ years in QA automation or test engineering, including meaningful time testing data pipelines rather than applications alone
- A data engineering background: you can read a pipeline, reason about a transformation, and write the SQL to verify it
- Expert-level SQL
- Experience with Medallion architecture, Delta Lake, and ELT-based data platforms
- Experience building automated suites that run in CI and gate deployment
- Demonstrable hands-on experience working on Databricks or similar platforms

Preferences

- Healthcare or life sciences experience preferred but not required
- Existing Databricks certification(s)
- Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog, Lakeflow pipelines, or Databricks Asset Bundles
- Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, or equivalent CI tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
- Familiarity with contract-based data validation standards such as ODCS
- Experience using LLM agents or MCP-connected tooling to run validations, triage failures, or draft defect reports
- Consulting or client-facing background

Pay Rate: $70 – $80 per hour (1099 independent contractor).

This is a contract engagement rather than a salaried employee role. Where a rate lands within the range depends on depth of data-pipeline testing experience and automation capability. Open to contractors anywhere in the United States.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/v4c-ai-databricks-qa-engineer
